`README.md`:

```md
# SR5 Tweak Menu

An in-game cheat menu for **Saints Row (2022)** on PC (Epic build, DirectX
12): the [SR Tweak Menu](https://github.com/00xJS/SR-Tweak-Menu) idea from
Saints Row 1, brought to the reboot. Work in progress.

![The menu in game: the Player tab](docs/menu.webp)

## Install

1. Download this repository (**Code > Download ZIP**) and unzip it.
2. Build the host: run `host\build.bat` (needs Visual Studio 2022 with
   **Desktop development with C++**).
3. Run `install.bat`. Give it the game's `sr5` folder as an argument if the
   game isn't in Epic's default folder. It puts `dinput8.dll` (the host) next
   to `SaintsRow_DX12.exe` and the menu in `sr5\TweakMenu\SRTweakMenu\`
   (an existing `mod.ini` is kept).
4. Start the game from Epic with **DirectX 12**. The DirectX 11 and Vulkan
   versions aren't supported yet: with them the menu stays off and the game
   runs as normal.
5. In game, open the menu:
   - **Keyboard:** F5
   - **Xbox controller:** hold RB and press D-pad Down

To uninstall, delete `sr5\dinput8.dll` and the `sr5\TweakMenu` folder.

## Controls

| | Keyboard | Xbox controller |
|---|---|---|
| Open / close menu | F5 | RB + D-pad Down |
| Move | Up / Down | D-pad Up / Down |
| Change value / browse list | Left / Right | D-pad Left / Right |
| Select | Enter | A |
| Change tab | PgUp / PgDn | LB / RB |
| Open a page | Enter | A |
| Back a page / close | Backspace | B |

While the menu is open its keys and the controller's buttons don't reach the
game; the sticks still do, so you can keep moving and looking around. The
controller is read through XInput: a PlayStation controller works when it
shows up as an Xbox one (Steam Input, DS4Windows).

## Features

Every row in the menu, tab by tab, in the menu's order. **Bold** names are
pages: Enter opens one, Backspace or B comes back. Every row has a help line
in the menu.

Cheats and tweaks start off (Keep my save clean starts on). Tweaks stay as you set them until you quit;
**Settings > Save tweaks for next time** keeps them for the next start (`sr5\TweakMenu\saved_tweaks.txt`); saved places are in
`sr5\TweakMenu\saved_places.txt`. Rows marked experimental in their help
line still need a test in play.

## Settings

Every number is in `sr5\TweakMenu\SRTweakMenu\mod.ini`: the key that opens
the menu, where it's drawn and how big, rows shown at once, the panel's
opacity and Keep my save clean. Restart the game after changing them.

## Notes

- **Your save.** Rows marked `*` are the game's "spicy" cheats: in the game,
  using one marks your save as cheated and pauses achievements. With
  **Settings > Keep my save clean** (on by default) the menu lets them run
  without marking the save; achievements pause only while a spicy cheat is
  on. Nothing outside the game's cheats (god mode, weapons, teleport) touches
  that at all.
- **Weapon tweaks** change the game's own weapon data, shared with everyone
  who carries that weapon: fire rate, magazines and one-hit kill apply to
  enemies' guns too (x2 to x10 damage doesn't). Pair them with God mode.
- Single player only.
- The repository contains no game files.

## How it works

**The host (`host/host.c`, built as `dinput8.dll`)**

- **Loading.** The game imports one function from `dinput8.dll`, so Windows
  loads the host from the game folder. Calls go on to a copy of the system
  DLL (`TweakMenu\dinput8_system.dll`): the Epic overlay hooks any
  `dinput8.dll`'s `DirectInput8Create` and would send the call back here.
- **Frames.** The game's main loop calls one function three times an
  iteration on the main thread; the host detours it and runs the menu's
  Lua 5.4 on the first call, about 60 times a second.
- **The game's Lua.** The game has one Lua 5.1 state, its interface's.
  `wml.game(code)` loads and runs code in it with the game's own
  `lua_load` and `lua_pcall` and returns the results. The game's Lua has
  no string, table or math library and a small memory pool.

**The menu (`SRTweakMenu/`)**

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `main.lua` | Runs the menu every frame; the live probe |
| `menu.lua` | Tabs, rows, input |
| `cheats.lua` | The game's cheats: the list, their state, switching them, keeping the save clean |
| `weapons.lua` | Weapon tweaks on the game's weapon data (fields, property lists, defaults) |
| `player.lua` | Health, movement, position, teleport, saved places, spawning, the car you're in |
| `tweaks.lua` | Settings kept for next time |
| `world.lua` | The clock (freeze, speed), pausing the world, notoriety |
| `wingsuit.lua` | Wingsuit tweaks (its data and your live copy) |
| `camera.lua` | Camera turn speed |
| `vdata.lua` | Shared: field addresses in the game's reflection data |
| `vehicles.lua` | Every vehicle and variant in the game's tables, generated |
| `perks.lua` | The game's perk classes that its code reads, generated |
| `sounds.lua` | Sound event names from the game's audio tables, generated |
| `sky.lua` | The game's time-of-day settings and ranges, generated |
| `anims.lua` | The game's animation tags in always-loaded sets, generated |
| `clothes.lua` | The game's wearables with a model, by slot, generated |
| `gameui.lua` | Draws the menu with the game's interface (vint text objects) |
| `luadump.lua` | Development: reads a game Lua function's constants from memory |

The `wml` table the Lua sees has the same shape as the SR1 menu's host:
`log`, `setting`, `read_*`/`write_*` (64-bit addresses),
`key_down`, `key_pressed`, `on_frame`, `pad`, plus `game(code)`,
`call(addr, ...)`, `buffer`, `read_string` and `base` (the executable's
load address).

**Testing**

- **Live probe.** Set `dev_probe = true` in the installed `mod.ini`. While the
  game runs, anything written to `sr5\TweakMenu\probe_in.lua` is run in the
  menu's Lua (with `game` and `dump` at hand), and what it prints goes to
  `sr5\TweakMenu\probe_out.txt`.
- **Research.** `research/` holds what was found in the game (addresses,
  the game's Lua globals, its interface functions) and `tools/` the Python
  scripts used to find it (they read `SaintsRow_DX12.exe` and the running
  game; `pip install pefile capstone numpy`). `tools/vpp.py` lists and
  extracts the game's `.vpp_pc` archives (its interface Lua is plain source
  there); what it extracts stays out of git. `tools/rcls.py` prints a
  reflection class's fields with offsets, `tools/vtbl.py` finds a class's
  vtable.

## Credits

- SR Tweak Menu by 00xJS and itsMJQ. Saints Row by Volition.
- Lua 5.4.9 by PUC-Rio, MIT licensed (`third_party/lua-5.4.9`).

SR5 Tweak Menu's own code is MIT licensed, see `LICENSE`.
```

`SRTweakMenu/camera.lua`:

```lua
-- SR5 Tweak Menu - the camera: turn speed past the options' limit, brightness.
--
-- The game keeps the turn speeds it uses as floats: mouse +2EAF170 (the
-- options slider gives 0.001 to 0.13), controller x +2EAFA10, y +2EAEE20.
-- It writes them again when the option is changed, so they're checked every
-- second: a value we didn't write is the game's own, and the multiplier is
-- applied to that.
--
-- Brightness: gml_engine_render_lock_exposure_value() makes the renderer copy
-- its current exposure into +2EAF178 on the next frame and use that from then
-- on (6.7 read live in daylight); the menu then shifts it. Locking stops the
-- game's own adjustment (going indoors, night), so it's undone with
-- gml_engine_render_unlock_exposure_value() when set back to the game's.

local Cam = { turn = 1, bright = 0 }
local SPEEDS = { 0x2EAF170, 0x2EAFA10, 0x2EAEE20 }
local EXPOSURE = 0x2EAF178
local base, written = {}, {}
local locked, lock_wait, exp_base, exp_written

local function update_bright()
  local a = wml.base + EXPOSURE
  if Cam.bright ~= 0 then
    if not locked then
      wml.game("gml_engine_render_lock_exposure_value()")
      locked, lock_wait = true, 2
      return
    end
    if lock_wait > 0 then lock_wait = lock_wait - 1; return end
    local now = wml.read_f32(a)
    if not exp_base or not exp_written or math.abs(now - exp_written) > 1e-4 then exp_base = now end
    exp_written = exp_base + Cam.bright
    if math.abs(now - exp_written) > 1e-4 then wml.write_f32(a, exp_written) end
  elseif locked then
    wml.game("gml_engine_render_unlock_exposure_value()")
    locked, exp_base, exp_written = false, nil, nil
  end
end

function Cam.update(frame)
  if (Cam.bright ~= 0 or locked) and frame % 10 == 3 then update_bright() end
  if frame % 60 ~= 50 then return end
  for _, off in ipairs(SPEEDS) do
    local a = wml.base + off
    local now = wml.read_f32(a)
    if Cam.turn ~= 1 then
      if not written[off] or math.abs(now - written[off]) > 1e-6 then base[off] = now end
      written[off] = base[off] * Cam.turn
      if math.abs(now - written[off]) > 1e-6 then wml.write_f32(a, written[off]) end
    elseif written[off] then
      if base[off] and math.abs(now - written[off]) <= 1e-6 then wml.write_f32(a, base[off]) end
      written[off], base[off] = nil, nil
    end
  end
end

function Cam.any_on() return Cam.turn ~= 1 or next(written) ~= nil or Cam.bright ~= 0 or locked end

return Cam

```

`SRTweakMenu/cheats.lua`:

```lua
-- SR5 Tweak Menu - the game's own cheats.
--
-- Saints Row (2022) has 43 cheats (the phone's Cheats app, vdo_cheat_app.lua).
-- Each is a cheat_info object; the app lists them with
-- vlib_info_object:ipairs("cheat_info") and calls cheat_activate(info),
-- which turns a toggle cheat on or off and fires a one-shot one.
-- tostring(info) is `Info: <crc> : "name"`: that's how we find one again.
-- Cheats whose m_allow_progression is false are "spicy".
--
-- Spicy flags (bytes in the exe's data; the game's own setters are
-- +662D70 / +662DA0, which write all three):
--   +5BE2B65  spicy cheats allowed this session. cheat_can_activate lets a
--             spicy cheat run only while it's set, and the achievement code
--             (+AD7F40) skips unlocking while it's set.
--   +5BEF714  set alongside it.
--   +3111664  "this save has cheated": sticky, and saved with the game
--             (save section cheat_savegame_state).
-- Keeping the save clean (keep_clean): +3111664 stays 0, so saves aren't
-- marked; the session flags are set only for the moment a spicy cheat is
-- used or while one is on, and cleared again after.

local C = { list = {}, by_name = {}, loaded = false }
local SPICY_SESSION, SPICY_SESSION2, SAVE_CHEATED = 0x5BE2B65, 0x5BEF714, 0x3111664

-- Runs code in the game's Lua; returns its results, or nil and logs.
local function game(code)
  local r = table.pack(wml.game(code))
  if not r[1] then wml.log("cheats: game Lua error: " .. tostring(r[2])); return nil end
  return table.unpack(r, 2, r.n)
end

function C.load()
  C.list, C.by_name = {}, {}
  local count = game([[local n = 0 for _ in vlib_info_object:ipairs("cheat_info") do n = n + 1 end return n]])
  if not count or count == 0 then return false end
  for first = 1, count, 8 do
    local r = table.pack(game([[
      local i, o = 0, {}
      for _, info in vlib_info_object:ipairs("cheat_info") do
        i = i + 1
        if i >= ]] .. first .. [[ and i < ]] .. (first + 8) .. [[ then
          local spicy = info.m_allow_progression
          o[#o + 1] = tostring(info)
          o[#o + 1] = not (spicy and spicy:get_bool())
          o[#o + 1] = cheat_is_toggle(info) and true or false
        end
      end
      return unpack(o)
    ]]))
    for j = 1, r.n, 3 do
      local id = r[j]
      local name = id and id:match('"(.*)"')
      if name then
        local c = { id = id, name = name, spicy = r[j + 1], toggle = r[j + 2], active = false }
        C.list[#C.list + 1] = c
        C.by_name[name] = c
      end
    end
  end
  C.loaded = #C.list > 0
  wml.log("cheats: " .. #C.list .. " found")
  return C.loaded
end

-- Reads every toggle cheat's state (one game call).
function C.refresh()
  if not C.loaded then return end
  local r = table.pack(game([[
    local o = {}
    for _, info in vlib_info_object:ipairs("cheat_info") do
      o[#o + 1] = tostring(info)
      o[#o + 1] = cheat_is_active(info) and true or false
    end
    return unpack(o)
  ]]))
  for j = 1, r.n, 2 do
    local name = r[j] and r[j]:match('"(.*)"')
    if name and C.by_name[name] then C.by_name[name].active = r[j + 1] end
  end
end

function C.spicy_on() return game("return cheat_is_spicy_activated() and true or false") == true end

-- Lets spicy cheats run (the session flag only, not the save's mark).
function C.allow_spicy() wml.write_u8(wml.base + SPICY_SESSION, 1) end

-- Any spicy toggle cheat on?
function C.spicy_active()
  for _, c in ipairs(C.list) do if c.spicy and c.toggle and c.active then return true end end
  return false
end

-- Clears the save's mark, and the session flags when no spicy cheat is on.
-- Returns true if the save's mark had been set.
function C.keep_clean(clear_session)
  local marked = wml.read_u8(wml.base + SAVE_CHEATED) ~= 0
  if marked then wml.write_u8(wml.base + SAVE_CHEATED, 0) end
  if clear_session then
    wml.write_u8(wml.base + SPICY_SESSION, 0)
    wml.write_u8(wml.base + SPICY_SESSION2, 0)
  end
  return marked
end

-- The player's cash (the HUD wallet reads it the same way), or nil.
function C.cash()
  local v = game("local f = rawget(_G, 'get_currency_available') return f and f(CURRENCY_CASH)")
  return type(v) == "number" and v or nil
end

-- 1234567 -> "$1,234,567"
function C.money(v)
  if not v then return "?" end
  local s = tostring(math.floor(v))
  local neg = s:sub(1, 1) == "-"
  if neg then s = s:sub(2) end
  s = s:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)", "%1,"):reverse():gsub("^,", "")
  return (neg and "-$" or "$") .. s
end

-- Fires (or toggles) a cheat by name. Returns true if the game took it.
function C.activate(name)
  local c = C.by_name[name]
  if not c then return false end
  local ok = game([[
    for _, info in vlib_info_object:ipairs("cheat_info") do
      if tostring(info) == ]] .. string.format("%q", c.id) .. [[ then
        if not cheat_can_activate(info) then return false end
        cheat_activate(info)
        return true
      end
    end
    return false
  ]])
  if ok and c.toggle then c.active = not c.active end
  return ok == true
end

function C.set(name, on)
  local c = C.by_name[name]
  if not c or not c.toggle then return false end
  if c.active == on then return true end
  return C.activate(name)
end

return C

```

`SRTweakMenu/gameui.lua`:

```lua
-- SR5 Tweak Menu - drawing with the game's own interface (vint).
--
-- The menu is a column of text lines in one of the game's interface
-- documents (1920x1080 units, scaled to the screen; "fades" by default,
-- menu_document in mod.ini), made the way gml_lib.lua's audio debug display
-- makes its text: vint_object_create(name, "text", parent), then font,
-- anchor, tint. The parent is the document's root element; its global
-- anchor is taken off, so menu_x / menu_y are from the screen's top left.
--
-- Each line is a label and a value (two columns) with the text engine's own
-- shadow (as the HUD wallet's text). Tints are set in 0-255 (they read back
-- in 0-1). Text in [brackets] is read as markup
-- by the game, so the menu never shows square brackets.
--
-- The backing panel is a copy of a plain 16x16 bitmap from the same
-- document (the game scales and tints those into flat panels), stretched and
-- tinted black; its alpha is the menu opacity. It stays in its own document:
-- a copy moved into another document may have brought the game down once.
-- A bitmap's anchor is its centre. Creation order doesn't decide what's
-- drawn on top (the panel dimmed some lines and not others), so depth does:
-- the panel at +100, the text at -100 (lower depth is drawn in front).
-- Only lines whose text or colour changed are sent to the game, in one call
-- per frame.
--
-- Fitting: nothing may run past the panel. Each text is measured by the game
-- (vint_get_local_size at scale 1, in the game Lua function sr5tm_fit) and
-- scaled down until it fits its column: a row's label up to the value
-- column, its value to the panel's edge, a line without a value the panel's
-- width. Measures can lag a frame behind a new text, so shown lines are
-- fitted again a few times a second (U.refit). Long help text is wrapped onto
-- two lines first (U.wrap), from an average character width measured once.

local U = { lines = 0 }
local S = wml.setting
local X, Y = S("menu_x", 120), S("menu_y", 120)
local LINE_H, VALUE_X = S("menu_line", 34), S("menu_value_x", 560)
local WIDTH = S("menu_width", 1000)
local SCALE = S("menu_scale", 0.9)
local FONT = S("menu_font", "avant_garde_body")
local DOC = S("menu_document", "fades")
local PAD = 24
local GAP = 16       -- space kept between a label and its value
local handles = {}   -- [line] = { label, value }
local panel           -- the backing panel, or nil
local shown = {}     -- [line] = { key = }
local made = false
U.opacity = S("menu_opacity", 60)   -- percent

local function game(code)
  local r = table.pack(wml.game(code))
  if not r[1] then wml.log("gameui: game Lua error: " .. tostring(r[2])); return nil end
  return table.unpack(r, 2, r.n)
end

local function q(s) return string.format("%q", s) end

-- Makes `n` lines (hidden) and the panel. Returns true when the lines exist.
function U.create(n)
  local r = table.pack(game([[
    -- scales a text object down until it's at most `max` wide (at `base` it fits as is)
    rawset(_G, "sr5tm_fit", function(h, base, max)
      if not vint_object_exists(h) then return end
      vint_set_scale(h, 1, 1)
      local w = vint_get_local_size(h)
      local k = base
      if w and w > 0 and w * base > max then k = max / w end
      vint_set_scale(h, k, k)
    end)
    local doc = vint_document_find(]] .. q(DOC) .. [[)
    if not doc then return nil end
    local parent = vint_document_get_root_element(doc)
    if not parent then return nil end
    local px, py = vint_get_global_anchor(parent)
    -- the panel: a plain 16x16 bitmap from this document
    local bg = 0
    local function find(h)
      if not h or h == 0 then return nil end
      if vint_object_get_type(h) == 5 then
        local w, hh = vint_get_local_size(h)
        local sx, sy = vint_get_scale(h)
        if w and sx and sx ~= 0 and sy ~= 0 and w / sx == 16 and hh / sy == 16 then return h end
      end
      local c = vint_object_first_child(h)
      while c and c ~= 0 do
        local f = find(c)
        if f then return f end
        c = vint_object_next_sibling(c)
      end
      return nil
    end
    local src = find(parent)
    if src then
      bg = vint_object_clone(src)
      if bg and bg ~= 0 then
        vint_object_set_parent(bg, parent)
        vint_set_anchor(bg, ]] .. (X - PAD + (WIDTH + 2 * PAD) / 2) .. [[ - px, ]] .. (Y - PAD + (n * LINE_H + 2 * PAD) / 2) .. [[ - py)
        vint_set_scale(bg, ]] .. ((WIDTH + 2 * PAD) / 16) .. [[, ]] .. ((n * LINE_H + 2 * PAD) / 16) .. [[)
        vint_set_tint(bg, 0, 0, 0)
        vint_set_depth(bg, 100)
        vint_set_alpha(bg, 0)
        vint_set_visible(bg, false)
      else
        bg = 0
      end
    end
    local o = { bg }
    for i = 1, ]] .. n .. [[ do
      for j = 1, 2 do
        local h = vint_object_create("sr5tm_" .. i .. "_" .. j, "text", parent)
        vint_set_font(h, ]] .. q(FONT) .. [[)
        vint_set_scale(h, ]] .. SCALE .. ", " .. SCALE .. [[)
        vint_set_anchor(h, ]] .. X .. [[ - px + (j == 2 and ]] .. VALUE_X .. [[ or 0), ]] .. Y .. [[ - py + (i - 1) * ]] .. LINE_H .. [[)
        vint_set_shadow_enabled(h, true)
        vint_set_depth(h, -100)
        vint_set_text(h, "")
        vint_set_visible(h, false)
        o[#o + 1] = h
      end
    end
    return unpack(o)
  ]]))
  if r.n < n * 2 + 1 or not r[2] then wml.log("gameui: couldn't make the menu's text"); return false end
  handles, shown = {}, {}
  for i = 1, n do handles[i] = { r[(i - 1) * 2 + 2], r[(i - 1) * 2 + 3] } end
  panel = (r[1] or 0) ~= 0 and r[1] or nil
  U.lines, made = n, true
  -- the font's average character width (at scale 1), for wrapping
  local sample = "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog, then the next one does too"
  local w = game("local h = " .. handles[1][1] .. " vint_set_scale(h, 1, 1) vint_set_text(h, " .. q(sample) ..
    ") local w = vint_get_local_size(h) vint_set_text(h, '') vint_set_scale(h, " .. SCALE .. ", " .. SCALE .. ") return w")
  if type(w) == "number" and w > 0 then U.char_w = w / #sample end
  wml.log("gameui: " .. n .. " lines made" .. (panel and ", with a panel" or ", no panel (no bitmap to copy)") ..
    ", characters " .. (U.char_w and string.format("%.1f", U.char_w) or "unmeasured") .. " units wide")
  return true
end

-- How many characters fit across the panel at the menu's scale.
local function line_chars()
  if U.char_w then return math.max(30, math.floor(WIDTH / (U.char_w * SCALE)) - 2) end
  return 80
end

-- Splits `text` at spaces into at most `n` lines that fit the panel's width.
-- (The last line takes what's left; fitting shrinks it if it's still long.)
function U.wrap(text, n)
  local width, out, line = line_chars(), {}, ""
  for word in (text or ""):gmatch("%S+") do
    if line ~= "" and #line + 1 + #word > width and #out < n - 1 then
      out[#out + 1] = line
      line = word
    else
      line = line == "" and word or (line .. " " .. word)
    end
  end
  out[#out + 1] = line
  return out
end

-- The widest a line's label and value may be.
local function limits(value)
  if value ~= "" then return VALUE_X - GAP, WIDTH - VALUE_X end
  return WIDTH, WIDTH - VALUE_X
end

-- Runs fitting code; the first failure switches fitting off (logged once).
local function run_fits(fits)
  if U.no_fit or #fits == 0 then return end
  local ok, err = wml.game(table.concat(fits, "\n"))
  if not ok then U.no_fit = true; wml.log("gameui: fitting text is off: " .. tostring(err)) end
end

-- Fits every shown line again (measures may lag behind a new text).
function U.refit()
  if not made then return end
  local code = {}
  for i = 1, U.lines do
    local s, h = shown[i], handles[i]
    if s then
      code[#code + 1] = "sr5tm_fit(" .. h[1] .. ", " .. SCALE .. ", " .. s.max1 .. ") sr5tm_fit(" .. h[2] .. ", " .. SCALE .. ", " .. s.max2 .. ")"
    end
  end
  run_fits(code)
end

-- Are our objects still there? (Loading a save rebuilds the interface.)
function U.alive()
  if not made then return false end
  return game("return vint_object_exists(" .. handles[1][1] .. ") and true or false") == true
end

local COLOURS = {
  title = { 1, 0.80, 0.25 }, tabs = { 0.6, 0.8, 1 }, cursor = { 1, 0.80, 0.25 }, row = { 1, 1, 1 },
  off = { 0.65, 0.65, 0.65 }, help = { 0.85, 0.85, 0.85 }, status = { 0.5, 1, 0.5 }, warn = { 1, 0.55, 0.4 },
  on = { 0.5, 1, 0.5 },
}

local panel_shown, panel_alpha
local function panel_code(code, visible)
  if not panel then return end
  local a = math.max(0, math.min(100, U.opacity)) / 100
  if visible ~= panel_shown or (visible and a ~= panel_alpha) then
    code[#code + 1] = "vint_set_alpha(" .. panel .. ", " .. a .. ") vint_set_visible(" .. panel .. ", " .. tostring(visible and a > 0) .. ")"
    panel_shown, panel_alpha = visible, a
  end
end

-- Shows `rows`: { { label =, value =, colour =, value_colour = } ... }; nil hides everything.
function U.show(rows)
  if not made then return end
  local code, fits = {}, {}
  panel_code(code, rows ~= nil)
  for i = 1, U.lines do
    local want = rows and rows[i]
    local old = shown[i]
    local h = handles[i]
    if not want then
      if old then
        code[#code + 1] = "vint_set_visible(" .. h[1] .. ", false) vint_set_visible(" .. h[2] .. ", false)"
        shown[i] = nil
      end
    else
      local label, value = (want.label or ""):gsub("[%[%]]", ""), (want.value or ""):gsub("[%[%]]", "")
      local c = COLOURS[want.colour or "row"] or COLOURS.row
      local vc = COLOURS[want.value_colour or want.colour or "row"] or c
      -- vint_set_tint takes 0-255 (vint_get_tint gives back 0-1)
      c = { math.floor(c[1] * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c[2] * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c[3] * 255 + 0.5) }
      vc = { math.floor(vc[1] * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(vc[2] * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(vc[3] * 255 + 0.5) }
      local key = label .. "\0" .. value .. "\0" .. (want.colour or "") .. "\0" .. (want.value_colour or "")
      if not old or old.key ~= key then
        code[#code + 1] = "vint_set_text(" .. h[1] .. ", " .. q(label) .. ") vint_set_text(" .. h[2] .. ", " .. q(value) .. ")"
        code[#code + 1] = "vint_set_tint(" .. h[1] .. ", " .. c[1] .. ", " .. c[2] .. ", " .. c[3] .. ")"
        code[#code + 1] = "vint_set_tint(" .. h[2] .. ", " .. vc[1] .. ", " .. vc[2] .. ", " .. vc[3] .. ")"
        local max1, max2 = limits(value)
        fits[#fits + 1] = "sr5tm_fit(" .. h[1] .. ", " .. SCALE .. ", " .. max1 .. ") sr5tm_fit(" .. h[2] .. ", " .. SCALE .. ", " .. max2 .. ")"
        if not old then code[#code + 1] = "vint_set_visible(" .. h[1] .. ", true) vint_set_visible(" .. h[2] .. ", true)" end
        shown[i] = { key = key, max1 = max1, max2 = max2 }
      end
    end
  end
  if #code > 0 then game(table.concat(code, "\n")) end
  -- fitting in its own call: if measuring ever fails, the text is still set
  run_fits(fits)
end

function U.forget() made, handles, shown, panel, panel_shown, panel_alpha, U.lines = false, {}, {}, nil, nil, nil, 0 end

-- Removes our objects from the game's interface.
function U.destroy()
  if made then
    local code = {}
    for _, h in ipairs(handles) do
      for j = 1, 2 do code[#code + 1] = "if vint_object_exists(" .. h[j] .. ") then vint_object_destroy(" .. h[j] .. ") end" end
    end
    if panel then code[#code + 1] = "if vint_object_exists(" .. panel .. ") then vint_object_destroy(" .. panel .. ") end" end
    game(table.concat(code, "\n"))
  end
  U.forget()
end

return U
```

`SRTweakMenu/luadump.lua`:

```lua
-- Reads a game Lua 5.1 function's constants (and its nested functions')
-- straight from memory: what it calls and which fields and names it uses.
-- Stock 5.1 layout on x64: LClosure +0x20 = Proto*; Proto +0x10 k,
-- +0x20 p, +0x40 source, +0x4C sizek, +0x58 sizep, +0x60 linedefined.
-- TValue 16 bytes (value, type at +8); TString text at +0x18, length +0x10.

local M = {}
local R64, R32, RF64 = wml.read_u64, wml.read_u32, wml.read_f64

local function tstring(ts)
  local len = R64(ts + 0x10)
  if len > 4096 then return "<?>" end
  return wml.read_string(ts + 0x18, len)
end

local function proto_consts(p, depth, out)
  local sizek, sizep = R32(p + 0x4C), R32(p + 0x58)
  if sizek > 5000 or sizep > 500 then out[#out + 1] = "<bad proto>"; return end
  local k, items = R64(p + 0x10), {}
  for i = 0, sizek - 1 do
    local tv = k + i * 16
    local t = R32(tv + 8)
    if t == 4 then items[#items + 1] = tstring(R64(tv))
    elseif t == 3 then items[#items + 1] = tostring(RF64(tv))
    elseif t == 1 then items[#items + 1] = R32(tv) ~= 0 and "true" or "false"
    end
  end
  out[#out + 1] = string.rep("  ", depth) .. "[line " .. R32(p + 0x60) .. "] " .. table.concat(items, " ")
  local pp = R64(p + 0x20)
  for i = 0, sizep - 1 do proto_consts(R64(pp + i * 8), depth + 1, out) end
end

-- dump(expr): expr is game Lua that evaluates to a function.
function M.dump(expr)
  local ok, s = game("return tostring(" .. expr .. ")")
  if not ok then return "error: " .. tostring(s) end
  local addr = tonumber((s or ""):match("function: (%x+)") or "", 16)
  if not addr then return "not a function: " .. tostring(s) end
  if wml.read_u8(addr + 0x0A) ~= 0 then return "C function" end
  local p = R64(addr + 0x20)
  local out = { "source " .. tstring(R64(p + 0x40)) }
  proto_consts(p, 0, out)
  return table.concat(out, "\n")
end

return M

```

`SRTweakMenu/main.lua`:

```lua
-- SR5 Tweak Menu - main loop.
--
-- Runs the menu every frame. With dev_probe on (mod.ini) it also runs the
-- live probe: anything written to TweakMenu\probe_in.lua is run here (with
-- `game`, a shortcut for wml.game, and `dump`), what it prints goes to
-- TweakMenu\probe_out.txt, and the input is renamed to probe_done.lua.

local probe_on = wml.setting("dev_probe", false)
local probe_in = wml.root .. "\\probe_in.lua"
local probe_out = wml.root .. "\\probe_out.txt"

local function show(v)
  if type(v) == "string" then return string.format("%q", v) end
  return tostring(v)
end

-- game(code) -> ok, ...  (code runs in the game's Lua 5.1; use `return`)
function game(code) return wml.game(code) end

-- dump(...): the values game() returned, as one line.
function dump(...)
  local t = {}
  for i = 1, select("#", ...) do t[#t + 1] = show((select(i, ...))) end
  return table.concat(t, ", ")
end

MENU = require("menu")

local tick = 0
local function run_probe()
  local f = io.open(probe_in, "r")
  if not f then return end
  local code = f:read("a")
  f:close()
  os.remove(wml.root .. "\\probe_done.lua")
  os.rename(probe_in, wml.root .. "\\probe_done.lua")
  wml.log("probe: running " .. #code .. " bytes")
  local out = {}
  local env = setmetatable({
    print = function(...)
      local t = {}
      for i = 1, select("#", ...) do t[#t + 1] = tostring((select(i, ...))) end
      out[#out + 1] = table.concat(t, "\t")
    end,
  }, { __index = _G })
  local fn, err = load(code, "=probe", "t", env)
  local ok, res = false, err
  if fn then ok, res = pcall(fn) end
  if not ok then out[#out + 1] = "ERROR: " .. tostring(res) end
  local o = io.open(probe_out, "w")
  if o then o:write(table.concat(out, "\n"), "\n"); o:close() end
end

local menu_error
wml.on_frame(function()
  -- a menu error mustn't stop the probe, or nothing can be fixed live
  local ok, err = pcall(MENU.update)
  if not ok and err ~= menu_error then menu_error = err; wml.log("menu error: " .. tostring(err)) end
  tick = tick + 1
  if probe_on and tick % 15 == 0 then run_probe() end
end)

wml.log("main.lua loaded; probe " .. (probe_on and "on" or "off"))

```

`SRTweakMenu/menu.lua`:

```lua
-- SR5 Tweak Menu - the on-screen menu.
--
-- As in SR1: tabs across the top, a cursor down the rows, a help line under
-- them. Keys: F5 opens and closes, Up/Down move, Left/Right change a choice,
-- Enter toggles or runs, Backspace closes, PgUp/PgDn change tab.
-- Controller: hold RB and press D-pad Down to open or close, D-pad moves,
-- A selects, B closes, LB/RB change tab.
--
-- Rows are the game's own cheats (cheats.lua); a row whose cheat the game
-- doesn't have (a DLC not installed) is left out.
--
-- Spicy cheats (*): with "Keep my save clean" on (the default) the menu
-- lets them run without marking the save: the session flag is set just for
-- them and cleared once none is on (achievements pause only meanwhile),
-- and the save's "cheated" mark is kept at 0.

local C = require("cheats")
local U = require("gameui")
local W = require("weapons")
local P = require("player")
local T = require("tweaks")
local Wd = require("world")
local WS = require("wingsuit")
local Cam = require("camera")
local S = wml.setting

local M = { open = false, tab = 1, cursor = {}, status = "", status_kind = "status", status_frames = 0,
  clean = S("keep_save_clean", true), spicy_hold = 0 }
local ROWS = S("menu_rows", 11)
local LINES = ROWS + 5   -- title, tabs, rows, two help lines, status
local OPEN_KEY = tostring(S("menu_key", "F5"))

local function toggle(cheat, label, help) return { kind = "toggle", cheat = cheat, label = label, help = help } end
local function action(cheat, label, help) return { kind = "action", cheat = cheat, label = label, help = help } end
local function choice(label, help, options, kind) return { kind = kind or "choice", label = label, help = help, options = options, sel = 1 } end
-- A player setting (a field of player.lua): Left/Right or Enter changes it.
local function pset(key, label, help, options) return { kind = "pset", key = key, label = label, help = help, options = options, sel = 1, save_key = "player." .. key } end
-- A game option or setting reached through the game's own Lua: `get` is an
-- expression giving the current value (nil: none), `set` a format with %s
-- for the new value. Its value is read when the menu opens; the first choice
-- is then the game's own value.
local function opt(label, help, get, set, options, save) return { kind = "opt", label = label, help = help, get = get, set = set, options = options, sel = 1, save_key = save } end
-- A one-press action that runs game Lua (`confirm`: needs a second press).
local function gcall(label, help, code, confirm) return { kind = "gcall", label = label, help = help, code = code, confirm = confirm } end
local function difficulty(i, label)
  local options = {}
  for v = 0, 10 do options[#options + 1] = { tostring(v), v / 10 } end
  return opt("Difficulty: " .. label, "Experimental: the pause menu's custom difficulty slider (saved with your game, as there).",
    "options_get_difficulty(" .. i .. ")", "options_set_difficulty(" .. i .. ", %s)", options)
end
-- A choice of game calls: Left/Right picks, Enter runs the picked code.
local function gchoice(label, help, options) return { kind = "gchoice", label = label, help = help, options = options, sel = 1 } end
local function voices()
  local out = {}
  for _, v in ipairs({ "player_f1", "player_f2", "player_f3", "player_f4", "player_m1", "player_m2", "player_m3", "player_m4" }) do
    local label = (v:find("_f") and "Female " or "Male ") .. v:sub(-1)
    out[#out + 1] = { label, "customization_set_avatar_persona('" .. v .. "') return '" .. label .. "'" }
  end
  return out
end
local function award(what, amounts)
  local out = {}
  for _, a in ipairs(amounts) do out[#out + 1] = { a[1], "gml_collectibles_award(string_crc('" .. what .. "'), " .. a[2] .. ") return '" .. a[1] .. " given'" } end
  return out
end
-- A wingsuit setting (wingsuit.lua), applied at once.
local function wsset(key, label, help, options) return { kind = "wsset", key = key, label = label, help = help, options = options, sel = 1, save_key = "wingsuit." .. key } end
-- A weapon setting: Left/Right (or Enter) changes it and applies it at once.
local function wset(key, label, help, options) return { kind = "wset", key = key, label = label, help = help, options = options, sel = 1, save_key = "weapons." .. key } end

-- From the game's tables: every HQ prop by the size of spot it's meant for, props made
-- for spawning, and every song.
local CRIB_PROPS = {
  { "Huge: Boot hill head cart", "crib-placeable-boot-hill-head-cart_01a" },
  { "Huge: Boot hill medicine cart", "crib-placeable-boot-hill-medicine-cart_01a" },
  { "Huge: Bottle liquor", "crib-placeable-bottle-liquor_08a" },
  { "Huge: Cactus cowboy", "crib-placeable-cactus-cowboy_01a" },
  { "Huge: Dustfaire paper airplane", "crib-placeable-dustfaire-paper-airplane_01a" },
  { "Huge: Electric chicken", "crib-placeable-electric-chicken_01a" },
  { "Huge: Fabulous egg", "crib-placeable-fabulous-egg_01d" },
  { "Huge: Owl windmill installation", "crib-placeable-owl-windmill-installation_01a" },
  { "Huge: Prop xmas tree", "crib-placeable-prop_xmas-tree_01" },

-- Every vehicle and variant, for Any vehicle.
local VEH = require("vehicles")
local ANY_VEHICLES = {}
for _, v in ipairs(VEH.list) do ANY_VEHICLES[#ANY_VEHICLES + 1] = { v[1], v[2], v[3] } end
local function any_variants(i)
  local out = {}
  for _, p in ipairs(ANY_VEHICLES[i][3]) do out[#out + 1] = { p[1] .. " (" .. p[2] .. ")", p[1] } end
  return out
end
local PERK_LIST = require("perks")
-- Animations and clothes, generated.
local ANIM_LIST = {}
for _, a in ipairs(require("anims")) do ANIM_LIST[#ANIM_LIST + 1] = { a[1] .. (a[4] == 1 and " (never used)" or ""), a[1], a[2], a[3] } end
local CLOTHES = require("clothes")
local CLOTH_SLOTS = {}
for i, c in ipairs(CLOTHES) do CLOTH_SLOTS[i] = { c[1]:gsub("_", " "), c[1], i } end
local function cloth_items(i)
  local out = {}
  for j, n in ipairs(CLOTHES[i][2]) do out[j] = { (n:gsub("^clo_", ""):gsub("_", " ")), n } end
  return out
end
local SKY_LIST = require("sky")
local SOUND_LIST = {}
for _, n in ipairs(require("sounds")) do SOUND_LIST[#SOUND_LIST + 1] = { n, n } end

do
  local by_label, home = {}, {}
  for _, t in ipairs(TABS) do
    for _, r in ipairs(t.rows) do by_label[r.label] = r; home[r] = t.name end
  end
  local used, built = {}, {}
  local function take(label)
    local r = by_label[label]
    if r and not used[r] then used[r] = true; return r end
    return nil
  end
  for _, spec in ipairs(LAYOUT) do
    local rows = {}
    for _, item in ipairs(spec[2]) do
      if type(item) == "string" then
        local r = take(item)
        if r then rows[#rows + 1] = r end
      else
        local page = { kind = "page", label = item[1], help = item[2], rows = {} }
        for _, label in ipairs(item[3]) do
          local r = take(label)
          if r then page.rows[#page.rows + 1] = r end
        end
        if #page.rows > 0 then rows[#rows + 1] = page end
      end
    end
    built[#built + 1] = { name = spec[1], rows = rows }
  end
  for _, t in ipairs(TABS) do
    for _, r in ipairs(t.rows) do
      if not used[r] then
        wml.log("menu: row not in a page: " .. tostring(r.label))
        for _, b in ipairs(built) do if b.name == home[r] then b.rows[#b.rows + 1] = r end end
      end
    end
  end
  TABS = built
end

-- Settings kept from last time (tweaks.lua).
local function all_rows()
  local rows = {}
  for _, t in ipairs(TABS) do
    for _, r in ipairs(t.rows) do
      if r.kind == "page" then for _, c in ipairs(r.rows) do rows[#rows + 1] = c end
      else rows[#rows + 1] = r end
    end
  end
  return rows
end
-- What's on screen: the page you're in, or the tab.
local function view() return M.page or TABS[M.tab] end
local function view_cursor() if M.page then return M.page.cursor or 1 end return M.cursor[M.tab] or 1 end
-- Puts a row's value where its module reads it.
local function set_value(r, v)
  if r.kind == "wset" then W.set[r.key] = v elseif r.kind == "pset" then P[r.key] = v
  elseif r.kind == "wdset" then Wd[r.key] = v
  elseif r.kind == "wsset" then WS.set[r.key] = v
  elseif r.kind == "mvset" then P.move[r.key] = v
  elseif r.kind == "carset" then P.car[r.key] = v
  elseif r.kind == "camset" then Cam[r.key] = v
  elseif r.kind == "mset" then M[r.key] = v end
end
-- A menu tweak (not a game option, the HUD or the menu's own settings).
local function tweak_row(r)
  return (r.save_key or r.kind == "wdset") and r.options and r.kind ~= "opt" and r.kind ~= "hud" and r.kind ~= "mset"
end
local function apply_saved()
  for _, row in ipairs(all_rows()) do
    local i = T.pick(row)
    if i then
      row.sel = i
      set_value(row, row.options[i][2])
    end
  end
  local kept = SR5TM_SESSION or T.saved
  if kept.clean then M.clean = kept.clean == "on" end
  if kept.opacity then U.opacity = tonumber(kept.opacity) or U.opacity end
  M.unsaved = SR5TM_UNSAVED
end
-- Changing a tweak keeps it for this session (and through a reload of these files); only
-- Save writes the file. The menu used to reread the launch copy on a reload, which undid
-- whatever had been set since.
local function saveable()
  local rows = all_rows()
  rows[#rows + 1] = { save_key = "clean", options = { { M.clean and "on" or "off" } }, sel = 1 }
  rows[#rows + 1] = { save_key = "opacity", options = { { tostring(U.opacity) } }, sel = 1 }
  -- with All tweaks off, the tweaks put aside are what's kept
  local function swap() for r, sel in pairs(M.stash or {}) do r.sel, M.stash[r] = sel, r.sel end end
  return rows, swap
end
function M.save_tweaks()
  local rows, swap = saveable()
  swap()
  local kept = {}
  for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
    if row.options and row.save_key and row.options[row.sel] then kept[row.save_key] = row.options[row.sel][1] end
  end
  swap()
  local differs = false
  for k, v in pairs(kept) do if T.saved[k] ~= v then differs = true end end
  SR5TM_SESSION, SR5TM_UNSAVED, M.unsaved = kept, differs, differs
end
function M.save_now()
  local rows, swap = saveable()
  swap()
  local ok = T.save(rows)
  swap()
  if ok then T.load(); SR5TM_UNSAVED, M.unsaved = false, false end
  return ok
end

-- All tweaks off: every menu tweak to the game's, the choices put aside;
-- on: they come back.
function M.pause_tweaks(off)
  if off and not M.stash then
    M.stash = {}
    for _, r in ipairs(all_rows()) do
      if tweak_row(r) and r.sel ~= 1 then M.stash[r] = r.sel; r.sel = 1; set_value(r, r.options[1][2]) end
    end
    W.restore(); WS.restore()
    M.gun_dirty = true
  elseif not off and M.stash then
    for r, sel in pairs(M.stash) do r.sel = sel; set_value(r, r.options[sel][2]) end
    M.stash = nil
    if W.any_on() then W.apply() end
    if WS.any_on() then WS.apply() end
    M.gun_dirty = true
  end
  M.tweaks_paused = off
end
apply_saved()

-- Rows only for cheats this game has; options likewise.
local function prune()
  local lists = {}
  for _, tab in ipairs(TABS) do
    lists[#lists + 1] = tab
    for _, row in ipairs(tab.rows) do if row.kind == "page" then lists[#lists + 1] = row end end
  end
  for _, tab in ipairs(lists) do
    local kept = {}
    for _, row in ipairs(tab.rows) do
      if row.kind == "page" then kept[#kept + 1] = row
      elseif row.cheat then
        if C.by_name[row.cheat] then kept[#kept + 1] = row end
      elseif row.options and (row.kind == "choice" or row.kind == "filter") then   -- options that are cheats
        local opts = {}
        for _, o in ipairs(row.options) do if o[2] == false or C.by_name[o[2]] then opts[#opts + 1] = o end end
        row.options = opts
        if #opts > 0 then kept[#kept + 1] = row end
      else
        kept[#kept + 1] = row
      end
    end
    tab.rows = kept
  end
end

-- A game name for the menu: underscores to spaces, each word capitalised.
local function pretty(name) return (name:gsub("_", " "):gsub("(%a)(%w*)", function(a, b) return a:upper() .. b end)) end

-- The names of every object of a class (the game's tostring of each), a
-- batch a call. Each call stops walking once its batch is full: walking a
-- class makes a userdata per object, and the game's Lua has a small pool
-- (the 14,000 voice line situations ran it out when walked whole each time).
-- `collect`: a full collection first, for very long classes.
local function names_of(cls, collect, n)
  local out, first, N = {}, 1, n or 25
  while true do
    local res = table.pack(wml.game((collect and 'collectgarbage("collect") ' or "") .. [[local i, o = 0, {} for _, x in vlib_info_object:ipairs("]] .. cls .. [[") do
      i = i + 1 if i >= ]] .. first .. [[ then o[#o + 1] = tostring(x) if #o == ]] .. N .. [[ then break end end end return #o, unpack(o)]]))
    if not res[1] then break end
    for j = 3, res.n do out[#out + 1] = res[j] end
    first = first + N
    if res[2] < N then break end
  end
  return out
end
-- every object of a class: { name, hash (the name's hash, from its id) }
local function names_of_objects(cls)
  local out, first, N = {}, 1, 20
  while true do
    local res = table.pack(wml.game([[local i, o = 0, {} for _, x in vlib_info_object:ipairs("]] .. cls .. [[") do
      i = i + 1 if i >= ]] .. first .. [[ then o[#o + 1] = tostring(x) o[#o + 1] = x if #o == ]] .. (2 * N) .. [[ then break end end end return #o, unpack(o)]]))
    if not res[1] then break end
    for j = 3, res.n, 2 do
      local p = tonumber(tostring(res[j + 1]):match("(%x+)>$") or "", 16)
      if p then out[#out + 1] = { name = res[j]:match('"(.*)"') or res[j], hash = (wml.read_u64(p + 0x28) >> 32) & 0xFFFFFFFF, class = wml.read_u64(p + 0x28) & 0xFFFFFFFF } end
    end
    first = first + N
    if res[2] < 2 * N then break end
  end
  return out
end

-- The player's voice lines: of the game's ~14,000 line situations (nearly
-- all mission dialogue), the generic ones a character says anywhere. Loaded
-- the first time the row is used (about a second), with a collection each
-- call, then the game's Lua collected again.
local VOICE = { combat = true, voice = true, special = true, misc = true, observe = true, threat = true, cower = true, flee = true, drunk = true }
local function load_voice_lines(row)
  for _, l in ipairs(names_of("gml_line_situation", true, 200)) do
    local name = l:match('"(.*)"') or l
    local pre = name:match("^(%a+)_")
    if pre and VOICE[pre] and not name:find("%d%d") then row.options[#row.options + 1] = { pretty(name), l, name } end
  end
  wml.game('collectgarbage("collect")')
  table.sort(row.options, function(a, b) return a[1] < b[1] end)
  row.loaded = true
end

-- The game's factions (gml_faction), by name hash: which clear cheat is
-- theirs and whether they're police (police, Marshal) or a gang.
local function load_factions()
  M.factions = {}
  local names = {}
  for _, f in ipairs(names_of_objects("gml_faction")) do
    local n = f.name:lower()
    names[#names + 1] = f.name
    if n:find("marshal") then M.factions[f.hash] = { cheat = "clear_marshal", group = "police" }
    elseif n:find("police") or n:find("cop") then M.factions[f.hash] = { cheat = "clear_police", group = "police" }
    elseif n:find("idol") then M.factions[f.hash] = { cheat = "clear_idols", group = "gangs" }
    elseif n:find("pantero") then M.factions[f.hash] = { cheat = "clear_panteros", group = "gangs" } end
  end
  wml.log("factions: " .. table.concat(names, ", "))
end

local function play_emote(id)
  return wml.game([[for _, e in vlib_info_object:ipairs("collectible_emote") do if tostring(e) == ]] .. string.format("%q", id) .. [[ then
    emote_play_in_world(e) return end end]])
end

local function say(text, kind) M.status, M.status_kind, M.status_frames = text, kind or "status", 240 end

local function is_spicy(name) local c = C.by_name[name]; return c and c.spicy end

local function fire(name, row, label)
  local c = C.by_name[name]
  if c.toggle and c.active then
    if C.activate(name) then say(label .. ": off") else say(label .. ": the game refused", "warn") end
    return
  end
  -- A spicy cheat runs only while the session flag is set: set it, and keep
  -- it a couple of seconds for one-shot cheats to finish.
  if c.spicy then C.allow_spicy(); M.spicy_hold = 120 end
  local cash_before = name == "cash" and C.cash()
  if C.activate(name) then
    say(label .. (c.toggle and ": on" or ": done"))
    -- The cash cheat pays out a moment later: check and report the change.
    if cash_before then M.cash_check = { before = cash_before, frames = 30 } end
  else
    say(label .. ": the game refused right now", "warn")
  end
end

-- Unlocks, a few at a time over the next frames (M.unlock.queue):
-- * collectibles: gml_collectibles_award(name hash, 1) for every object of
--   the collectible classes, as the game awards a found one.
-- * stores: each store inventory's clothing gets m_purchased on its data record
--   (what the wardrobe's owned list reads; the award does nothing for clothing),
--   its emotes are awarded like a collectible. (The game's console handler for
--   this, +A68880, crashed it.) Store weapons are left to Own every weapon.
-- * weapons: +988830(info, 1), the owned flag buying a weapon sets.
-- Achievements wait meanwhile: the spicy session flag is held (the game's
-- achievement code skips while it's set).
local COLLECTIBLES = { "collectible_wearable_info", "collectible_emote", "collectible_weapon_info", "collectible_vehicle_info", "building_customization_prop_info" }
local function add_awards(q, classes)
  local batch
  for _, cls in ipairs(classes) do
    for _, o in ipairs(names_of_objects(cls)) do
      if not batch or #batch == 20 then batch = {}; q[#q + 1] = { award = batch } end
      batch[#batch + 1] = "gml_collectibles_award(" .. o.hash .. ", 1)"
    end
  end
end
-- What's left at 0 after the award (three emotes refuse it): m_available written
-- to 1 directly, as many as a step's call can return.
local REFUSED = { { "collectible_emote", "collectible_emote_state" }, { "skill_info", "skill_info_data" }, { "perk_entry", "perk_entry_state" } }
local unlock_queue
function unlock_queue(key, q)
  if key == "weapons" then
    for _, o in ipairs(names_of_objects("inventory_weapon_info")) do q[#q + 1] = { weapon = o.name } end
  elseif key == "travel" then
    add_awards(q, { "city_warp_point" })
  elseif key == "icons" then
    for _, cls in ipairs({ "discoverable_info", "diversion_info", "flashpoint_info" }) do
      for _, o in ipairs(names_of_objects(cls)) do q[#q + 1] = { icon = o.hash } end
    end
  elseif key == "stores" then
    for i, o in ipairs(names_of_objects("store_inventory_info")) do
      q[#q + 1] = { store = o.hash, index = i, first = 0 }
    end
  elseif key == "skills" then
    add_awards(q, { "skill_info" })
    q[#q + 1] = { refused = REFUSED[2] }
  elseif key == "perks" then
    add_awards(q, { "perk_entry", "perk_slot" })
    q[#q + 1] = { refused = REFUSED[3] }
  elseif key == "gang" then
    add_awards(q, { "gang_customization", "gang_vehicle_customization", "homie_info", "homie_outfit" })
  elseif key == "clothing" then
    q[#q + 1] = { clothing = true, first = 0 }
  elseif key == "skins" then
    for _ = 1, 10 do q[#q + 1] = { refused = { "weapon_skin", "weapon_skin_state" } } end
  elseif key == "tidy" then
    for _, o in ipairs(names_of_objects("inventory_weapon_info")) do
      if P.weapon_is_internal(o.name) then q[#q + 1] = { disown = o.name } end
    end
    q[#q + 1] = { clear_slots = true }
  elseif key == "everything" then
    for _, k in ipairs({ "travel", "weapons", "skins", "stores", "clothing", "skills", "perks", "gang", "collectibles", "icons" }) do unlock_queue(k, q) end
  else
    add_awards(q, COLLECTIBLES)
    q[#q + 1] = { refused = REFUSED[1] }
  end
end
local function start_unlock(row)
  local q = {}
  unlock_queue(row.key, q)
  if #q == 0 then say(row.label .. ": nothing found (load into the game first)", "warn"); return end
  M.unlock = { queue = q, label = row.label, done = 0, total = #q }
  say(row.label .. ": working...")
end
local function step_unlock()
  local u = M.unlock
  C.allow_spicy(); M.spicy_hold = math.max(M.spicy_hold, 300)
  local item = table.remove(u.queue, 1)
  if item and item.store then
    -- this store's clothing, 40 a step: the purchased flag on each item's data
    local r = table.pack(wml.game([[local i = 0 for _, s in vlib_info_object:ipairs("store_inventory_info") do i = i + 1 if i == ]] .. item.index .. [[ then
      local o, n = {}, 0
      for _, w in s.m_wearables:ipairs() do
        n = n + 1
        if n > ]] .. item.first .. [[ then
          local x = w:get_info("char_cust_wearable_info")
          if x:exists() then
            local d = x:get_data("char_cust_wearable_data")
            if d:exists() then o[#o + 1] = d.m_purchased end
          end
          if #o == 40 then break end
        end
      end
      return n, unpack(o) end end]]))
    local V = require("vdata")
    if r[1] then
      for j = 3, r.n do
        local a = V.field_addr(r[j])
        if a and wml.read_u8(a) == 0 then wml.write_u8(a, 1); u.items = (u.items or 0) + 1 end
      end
    end
    if r[1] and r.n - 2 == 40 then
      table.insert(u.queue, 1, { store = item.store, index = item.index, first = r[2] })
    else
      -- and its emotes, awarded like a collectible
      r = table.pack(wml.game([[local i = 0 for _, s in vlib_info_object:ipairs("store_inventory_info") do i = i + 1 if i == ]] .. item.index .. [[ then
        local o = {}
        for _, w in s.m_emotes:ipairs() do o[#o + 1] = w:get_info("collectible_emote") if #o == 60 then break end end
        return unpack(o) end end]]))
      local awards = {}
      if r[1] then
        for j = 2, r.n do
          local q = V.ptr(r[j])
          if q then awards[#awards + 1] = "gml_collectibles_award(" .. ((wml.read_u64(q + 0x28) >> 32) & 0xFFFFFFFF) .. ", 1)" end
        end
      end
      for i = 1, #awards, 20 do wml.game(table.concat(awards, " ", i, math.min(i + 19, #awards))) end
      u.items = (u.items or 0) + #awards
      u.done = u.done + 1
    end
  elseif item and item.disown then
    if P.disown_weapon(item.disown) then u.items = (u.items or 0) + 1 end
    u.done = u.done + 1
  elseif item and item.clear_slots then
    P.clear_internal_slots()
    u.done = u.done + 1
  elseif item and item.refused then
    local r = table.pack(wml.game([[local o = {} for _, x in vlib_info_object:ipairs("]] .. item.refused[1] .. [[") do
      local d = x:get_data("]] .. item.refused[2] .. [[")
      if d:exists() and d.m_available:get_number() <= 0 then o[#o + 1] = d.m_available if #o == 40 then break end end
    end return unpack(o)]]))
    local V = require("vdata")
    if r[1] then
      for j = 2, r.n do
        local a = V.field_addr(r[j])
        if a and wml.read_u32(a) == 0 then wml.write_u32(a, 1); u.items = (u.items or 0) + 1 end
      end
    end
    u.done = u.done + 1
  elseif item and item.clothing then
    -- every clothing record, 40 a step, whether a store sells it or not
    local r = table.pack(wml.game([[collectgarbage("collect") local o, n = {}, 0
      for _, x in vlib_info_object:ipairs("char_cust_wearable_info") do
        n = n + 1
        if n > ]] .. item.first .. [[ then
          local d = x:get_data("char_cust_wearable_data")
          if d:exists() then o[#o + 1] = d.m_purchased end
          if #o == 40 then break end
        end
      end
      return n, unpack(o)]]))
    local V = require("vdata")
    if r[1] then
      for j = 3, r.n do
        local a = V.field_addr(r[j])
        if a and wml.read_u8(a) == 0 then wml.write_u8(a, 1); u.items = (u.items or 0) + 1 end
      end
    end
    if r[1] and r.n - 2 == 40 then table.insert(u.queue, 1, { clothing = true, first = r[2] })
    else u.done = u.done + 1 end
  elseif item and item.weapon then
    if P.own_weapon(item.weapon) then u.done = u.done + 1 end
  elseif item and item.icon then
    -- gameplay_type_show_oi_node's call: +742650(&name hash, 1 show, 0 no banner)
    local buf = wml.buffer(12)
    wml.write_u32(buf, item.icon)
    wml.call(wml.base + 0x742650, buf, 1, 0)
    u.done = u.done + 1
  elseif item and item.award then
    if wml.game(table.concat(item.award, " ")) then u.done = u.done + 1 end
  end
  if #u.queue == 0 then
    say(u.label .. ": done (" .. u.done .. " of " .. u.total .. (u.label:find("stores") and (" stores, " .. (u.items or 0) .. " items)") or u.label:find("clothing") and (" lists, " .. (u.items or 0) .. " items)") or u.label:find("weapon") and " weapons)" or " batches)"))
    wml.log("unlock: " .. u.label .. ", " .. u.done .. " of " .. u.total .. (u.items and (", " .. u.items .. " items") or ""))
    M.unlock = nil
  end
end

local CROWD = { statue = { "statue_near", "turned to statues" }, unstatue = { "unstatue_near", "free again" }, flame = { "flame_near", "burning" }, unflame = { "unflame_near", "put out" },
  calm = { "calm_near", "calmed" }, revive = { "revive_near", "told to get up" }, strip = { "strip_near", "stripped" }, tough = { "tough_near", "toughened" }, stagger = { "stagger_near", "easier to stagger" }, unseen = { "unseen_near", "faded out" }, seen = { "seen_near", "faded in" },
  ragdoll = { "ragdoll_near", "ragdolled" }, kill = { "kill_near", "killed" }, fire = { "fire_near", "set on fire" },
  stun = { "stun_near", "stunned" }, launch = { "launch_near", "launched" }, zombies = { "zombies_near", "near an outbreak" }, riot = { "riot_near", "rioting" }, downed = { "downed_near", "won't die" }, follow = { "follow_near", "following you" }, float = { "float_near", "floating" }, dissolve = { "dissolve_near", "dissolving" }, toxic = { "toxic_near", "poisoned" }, dance = { "dance_near", "dancing" }, hostile = { "hostile_near", "turned on you" }, friendly = { "friendly_near", "on your side" } }
local function select_row(row)
  wml.log("row: " .. tostring(row.label) .. (row.options and row.options[row.sel] and (" = " .. tostring(row.options[row.sel][1])) or ""))   -- so a crash log says what was last pressed
  if M.stash then M.stash[row] = nil end   -- changed while All tweaks is off: keep the new choice
  if row.kind == "toggle" or row.kind == "action" then
    fire(row.cheat, row, row.label)
  elseif row.kind == "choice" then
    local o = row.options[row.sel]
    if o.max then
      -- raise it once every 3/4 s, enough times to reach the top
      M.raise = { name = o[2], label = row.label, left = 6, wait = 0 }
      say(row.label .. ": raising to the top")
    else
      fire(o[2], row, row.label .. " " .. o[1])
    end
  elseif row.kind == "mset" then
    M.adjust_mset(row, 1)
  elseif row.kind == "random_people" then
    local pick
    for _, r in ipairs(all_rows()) do if r.kind == "person" then pick = r end end
    if not pick or #pick.options == 0 then say("No characters (load into the game first)", "warn") else
      local n = 0
      for i = 1, 10 do
        local o = pick.options[math.random(#pick.options)]
        local a = i / 10 * 2 * math.pi
        if P.spawn_npc(o[2], math.cos(a) * 5, math.sin(a) * 5) then n = n + 1 end
      end
      say(n .. " random people spawned")
    end
  elseif row.kind == "unlock" then
    if M.unlock then say("Unlocking already: wait for it to finish", "warn")
    elseif M.pending_confirm ~= row then M.pending_confirm = row; say(row.label .. ": press again to confirm (saved with your game)", "warn")
    else M.pending_confirm = nil; start_unlock(row) end
  elseif row.kind == "gchoice" then
    local o = row.options[row.sel]
    local ok, msg = wml.game(o[2])
    say(row.label .. ": " .. tostring(ok and (msg or "done") or msg), ok and "status" or "warn")
  elseif row.kind == "camset" then
    M.adjust_camset(row, 1)
  elseif row.kind == "refill_ammo" then
    wml.call(wml.base + 0x662FF0)
    say("Ammo refilled")
  elseif row.kind == "weathernode" then
    local o = row.options[row.sel]
    if not o then say("No weathers (load into the game first)", "warn") else
      local ok, err = wml.game("gml_weather_state_set_node(" .. string.format("%q", o[2]) .. ")")
      say(ok and ("Weather: " .. o[1]) or ("Weather: " .. tostring(err)), ok and "status" or "warn")
    end
  elseif row.kind == "giveweapon" or row.kind == "voiceline" then
    if row.kind == "voiceline" and not row.loaded then load_voice_lines(row); say(#row.options .. " voice lines: Left/Right picks, Enter says it"); return end
    local o = row.options[row.sel]
    if not o then say("Nothing to pick (load into the game first)", "warn") else
      local code = row.kind == "giveweapon"
        and ([[for _, w in vlib_info_object:ipairs("inventory_weapon_info") do if tostring(w) == ]] .. string.format("%q", o[2]) .. [[ then weapon_swap_to_inventory(w) return end end]])
        or ("avatar_play_line_situation(" .. string.format("%q", o[3]) .. ")")
      local ok, err = wml.game(code)
      say(ok and (row.label .. ": " .. o[1]) or (row.label .. ": " .. tostring(err)), ok and "status" or "warn")
    end
  elseif row.kind == "waypoint" then
    local x, y, z, slot = P.waypoint()
    if not x then say("No waypoint set: put one on the map first", "warn")
    elseif P.teleport(x, y + 1, z) then say(slot == 0 and "Off to your waypoint" or "Off to the mission marker")
    else say("The game refused the teleport", "warn") end
  elseif row.kind == "cash_drop" then
    local o = row.options[row.sel]
    say(P.drop_cash(o[2], 0, 2, 8) and (o[1] .. " dropped ahead of you") or "Couldn't drop cash right now", "status")
  elseif row.kind == "weapon_drop" then
    local o = row.options[row.sel]
    local ok, v = wml.game("return string_crc(" .. string.format("%q", o and o[2] or "") .. ")")
    if not o then say("Nothing to pick (load into the game first)", "warn")
    else say(ok and P.drop_pickup(math.floor(v) & 0xFFFFFFFF, 1, 0, 1, 6) and (o[1] .. " dropped ahead of you") or "Couldn't drop it right now", "status") end
  elseif row.kind == "destroy_car" then
    if M.pending_confirm ~= row then M.pending_confirm = row; say(row.label .. ": press again to confirm", "warn")
    else
      M.pending_confirm = nil
      say(P.destroy_car() and "Boom" or "You're not in a vehicle", "status")
    end
  elseif row.kind == "reaction" then
    local o = row.options[row.sel]
    local n = P.near_reaction(o[2], 40)
    say(n == 0 and "Nobody near" or (n .. (n == 1 and " person: " or " people: ") .. o[1]))
  elseif row.kind == "arms" then
    local n = P.near_arms(row.armed, 40)
    say(n == 0 and "Nobody near" or (n .. (n == 1 and " person " or " people ") .. (row.armed and "re-armed" or "disarmed")))
  elseif row.kind == "play_as" then
    if row.back then say(P.back_to_self() and "You again" or "You're already you", "status")
    else say(P.play_as_spawned() and "You're them now: Back to yourself returns" or "Spawn someone first (World > Spawn person)", "status") end
  elseif row.kind == "outfit" then
    local o = row.options[row.sel]
    if not o then say("No saved looks", "warn") else
      P.look_first()
      local ok, err = wml.game([[local n, c = 0, gml_get_local_player():get_component_by_type("gml_component_character_customization")
        for _, p in vlib_info_data_object:ipairs("char_cust_player_saved_preset_data") do n = n + 1
          if n == ]] .. o[2] .. [[ then gml_customization_apply_player_preset(c, p, true, true) return end end]])
      say(ok and ("Wearing " .. o[1]) or tostring(err), ok and "status" or "warn")
    end
  elseif row.kind == "look_preset" then
    local o = row.options[row.sel]
    if not o then say("No presets", "warn")
    elseif M.pending_confirm ~= row then M.pending_confirm = row; say(row.label .. ": " .. o[1] .. ": press again to replace your character", "warn")
    else
      M.pending_confirm = nil
      P.look_first()
```
