```lua
    if lc then wml.call(wml.base + 0x1BB22F0, lc, P.car_brake_lights and 1 or 0) end
    st.brake = P.car_brake_lights or false
  end
  if P.car_gravity ~= (st.gravity or 1) then
    -- not through P.node: physics_set_gravity_factor_node (+1931450) reads node +8, and a stand-in has none: it
    -- crashed. What it ends in is the same message No clip sends: +486C10(object, 0, 6, 0, &factor).
    local b = wml.buffer(13)
    wml.write_f32(b, P.car_gravity)
    wml.call(wml.base + 0x486C10, v, 0, 6, 0, b)
    st.gravity = P.car_gravity
  end
end
-- One-press: a boost (vehicle_force_boost_node: plain cars may refuse), a jump
-- (physics_add_velocity_node), the next paint (the game's Lua, 0-based).
function P.car_boost()
  local v = P.vehicle_object()
  if not v then return false end
  P.node(0xBB4CF0, 0x29EB138, { { u = wml.read_u32(v + 0x58) }, { u = 3000 } })
  return true
end
function P.car_jump()
  local v = P.vehicle_object()
  if not v then return false end
  P.node(0x192F280, 0x2ABBA60, { { u = wml.read_u32(v + 0x58) }, { v = { 0, 12, 0 } }, { u = wml.read_u32(wml.base + 0x3C44910) } })
  return true
end
function P.car_next_paint()
  local ok, a, b = wml.game([[local c = vehicle_get_current():get_component_by_type("gml_component_vehicle_customization")
    local n, cur = #vehicle_get_paint_choices(c), vehicle_get_paint_choice(c)
    if n == 0 then return 0, 0 end
    local nxt = (cur + 1) % n
    vehicle_set_paint_choice(c, nxt)
    return nxt + 1, n]])
  return ok and a or nil, b
end
-- Spawned cars: the drop-car cheat's callback leaves the new car's id in +3C2261C.
P.spawned_cars = {}
local car_watch
function P.watch_spawned_car() car_watch = { was = wml.read_u32(wml.base + 0x3C2261C), frames = 600 } end
function P.update_car_watch()
  if not car_watch then return end
  local id = wml.read_u32(wml.base + 0x3C2261C)
  car_watch.frames = car_watch.frames - 1
  if id ~= car_watch.was and id ~= 0 then P.spawned_cars[#P.spawned_cars + 1] = id; car_watch = nil
  elseif car_watch.frames <= 0 then car_watch = nil end
end
function P.remove_spawned_cars()
  local mine, n = P.vehicle_object(), 0
  local left = {}
  for _, id in ipairs(P.spawned_cars) do
    local e = P.entry_of(id)
    if e and e == mine then left[#left + 1] = id
    elseif e and wml.read_u32(e + 0x58) == id then wml.call(wml.base + 0x1E6920, e + 0x58); n = n + 1 end
  end
  P.spawned_cars = left
  return n
end
-- What's drawn: a global render mask, +3389098: 0x8000 sky, 0x4000 particles,
-- 0x1000 shadows, 0x20000 tree billboards. One at a time here; the rest stay on.
P.render_hide = false
local render_bit
function P.update_render()
  local a = wml.base + 0x3389098
  local m = wml.read_u32(a)
  if render_bit then m = m | render_bit end
  render_bit = P.render_hide or nil
  if render_bit then m = m & ~render_bit & 0xFFFFFFFF end
  wml.write_u32(a, m)
end

-- Camera distance: the camera's follow distance, +0x7FC of component 0x1D (from
-- +1FCD10(+1B434C0(player + 0x58))), written every frame while it's changed. 0 is
-- from inside your head: aiming stays third-person. Original kept in a global.
P.cam_distance = false
function P.update_cam_distance()
  local e = P.object()
  if not e then return end
  local cam = wml.call(wml.base + 0x1FCD10, wml.call(wml.base + 0x1B434C0, e + 0x58))
  if cam == 0 then return end
  SR5TM_CAM_DIST = SR5TM_CAM_DIST or wml.read_f32(cam + 0x7FC)
  wml.write_f32(cam + 0x7FC, P.cam_distance or SR5TM_CAM_DIST)
end

-- Auto-teleport: a new player waypoint (slot 0) takes you there at once.
P.auto_waypoint = false
local waypoint_last
function P.update_auto_waypoint()
  local x, y, z, slot = P.waypoint()
  if not x or slot ~= 0 then waypoint_last = nil; return end
  if waypoint_last and math.abs(waypoint_last[1] - x) + math.abs(waypoint_last[2] - z) < 1 then return end
  waypoint_last = { x, z }
  P.teleport(x, y + 1, z)
end

-- Places on the map: the HUD's own icon list, Hud_oi_icons. Each has the object it's
-- on (obj_handle), its kind (oi_type) and what it is (gameplay_info: a store_info name
-- hash for stores). Only what the map has published so far.
function P.map_places(stores)
  local ok, s = wml.game([[collectgarbage("collect") local s = ""
    for _, i in pairs(Hud_oi_icons) do
      if i.obj_handle and i.gameplay_info and i.is_player ~= true then
        local st = vlib_info_object:get_object("store_info", i.gameplay_info):exists()
        if ]] .. (stores and "st" or "not st") .. [[ then
          s = s .. i.obj_handle .. "\t" .. tostring(st and vlib_info_object:get_object("store_info", i.gameplay_info) or i.oi_type) .. "\n"
        end
      end
    end
    return s]])
  local out = {}
  if ok then
    for id, name in tostring(s):gmatch("(%d+)\t([^\n]*)\n") do
      out[#out + 1] = { name:match('"(.*)"') or name, tonumber(id) }
    end
    table.sort(out, function(a, b) return a[1] < b[1] end)
  end
  return out
end
function P.go_to_object(id)
  local e = P.entry_of(id)
  if not e then return false end
  return P.teleport(s32(wml.read_u32(e + 0x30)) / 10000, s32(wml.read_u32(e + 0x34)) / 10000 + 1, s32(wml.read_u32(e + 0x38)) / 10000)
end

-- The car camera: +2EAED68 is how long it waits before swinging back, in seconds.
P.cam_delay = false
function P.update_cam_delay()
  local a = wml.base + 0x2EAED68
  SR5TM_CAM_DELAY = SR5TM_CAM_DELAY or wml.read_f32(a)
  wml.write_f32(a, P.cam_delay or SR5TM_CAM_DELAY)
end

-- Fire rate past the game's limit: the gun caches its refire delay in ms at +0x7B8,
-- which the property lists don't reach, and bit 0x20 of +0x7C4 skips the gate on the
-- firing animation (the game clears it on letting go). Every frame while it's above x1.
-- Originals by gun component. Money gun: +0x1CE8 counts shots.
SR5TM_REFIRE = SR5TM_REFIRE or {}
P.money_gun = false
local gun_comp, gun_wait, gun_shots = nil, 0, nil
local refire_frames, refire_shots = 0, nil
local function held_gun()
  gun_wait = gun_wait - 1
  if gun_wait <= 0 then
    gun_wait = 15
    local ok, s = wml.game("return tostring(gml_get_local_player_weapon())")
    local id = ok and tonumber((s or ""):match("object (%x+)") or "", 16)
    gun_comp = nil
    if id and id ~= 0 then
      local buf = wml.buffer(10) + 0x200
      wml.write_u32(buf, id)
      local e = wml.call(wml.base + 0x1C1F420, buf)
      local c = e ~= 0 and wml.call(wml.base + 0x49F8A0, e) or 0
      if c ~= 0 then gun_comp = c end
    end
  end
  return gun_comp
end
function P.update_refire(x)
  if type(x) ~= "number" then x = 1 end
  if x == 1 and next(SR5TM_REFIRE) == nil then return end
  local c = held_gun()
  if not c then return end
  if x ~= 1 then
    -- -1 means the gun hasn't initialized its section yet: never keep that as the original
    -- (dividing it gave a delay of days, and off wrote it back). Read again until it's real.
    local o = SR5TM_REFIRE[c]
    if not o or o >= 0x7FFFFFFF then
      o = wml.read_u32(c + 0x7B8)
      SR5TM_REFIRE[c] = o < 0x7FFFFFFF and o or nil
    end
    -- No faster than 20 shots a second: the first floor, 16 ms, took the game down.
    if o < 0x7FFFFFFF then wml.write_u32(c + 0x7B8, math.max(50, math.floor(o / x))) end
    if P.refire_gate ~= false then wml.write_u8(c + 0x7C4, wml.read_u8(c + 0x7C4) | 0x20) end
    -- a line a second while firing: the real rate, and the last thing before a crash
    refire_frames = refire_frames + 1
    if refire_frames >= 60 then
      local n = wml.read_u32(c + 0x1CE8)
      if refire_shots and n > refire_shots then wml.log(string.format("firing: %d shots in 1 s, delay %d ms (game's %d)", n - refire_shots, wml.read_u32(c + 0x7B8), o)) end
      refire_shots, refire_frames = n, 0
    end
  elseif SR5TM_REFIRE[c] then
    wml.write_u32(c + 0x7B8, SR5TM_REFIRE[c])
    SR5TM_REFIRE[c] = nil
  end
end
function P.update_money_gun()
  local c = held_gun()
  if not c then gun_shots = nil; return end
  local n = wml.read_u32(c + 0x1CE8)
  if gun_shots and n > gun_shots then P.drop_cash(50 * (n - gun_shots), 0, 1, 12) end
  gun_shots = n
end

-- People the menu spawned (their object ids), and removing them: +1E6920(&id)
-- destroys an object (the game's "gameplay util destroy"). An entry's own id
-- is at +0x58; ids are reused, so an id is only removed while its entry still
-- carries it.
P.spawned = {}
local spawn_pending = {}
-- Spawned people: left wandering, or (a moment after they appear) set on you.
P.spawn_hostile = false
local hostile_wait = {}
function P.hostile_pending() return #hostile_wait > 0 end
function P.update_hostile()
  local left = {}
  for _, h in ipairs(hostile_wait) do
    h.ticks = h.ticks - 1
    if h.ticks > 0 then left[#left + 1] = h
    elseif P.entry_of(h.id) then
      if h.mode == "guard" then P.make_follower(h.id)
      elseif h.mode == "army" then P.make_army(h.id)
      else P.make_hostile(h.id) end
    end
  end
  hostile_wait = left
end
function P.remember(obj) if obj then spawn_pending[#spawn_pending + 1] = obj end end
-- The spawner returns a spawn record: the person's id is at +0x70 (read live),
-- filled in once they exist.
local function spawn_settle()
  local left = {}
  for _, o in ipairs(spawn_pending) do
    local id = wml.read_u32(o + 0x70)
    if id ~= 0 and P.entry_of(id) then
      P.spawned[#P.spawned + 1] = id
      if P.spawn_hostile then hostile_wait[#hostile_wait + 1] = { id = id, ticks = 1, mode = P.spawn_hostile } end
    else left[#left + 1] = o end
  end
  spawn_pending = left
end
function P.spawned_pending() return #spawn_pending > 0 end
P.spawn_settle = spawn_settle
-- Playing as someone else: the local player record *(+5BDF320), +0x10 current object.
-- +1B44BC0(record, &id, 1) sets who's next, +1B44800(record) commits: the path the world
-- start uses. The game then reports them as the local player. You go back the same way,
-- and at once if that body disappears.
local function become(id)
  P.free_cam = false   -- with the camera taken over the game doesn't commit the switch
  local rec = wml.read_u64(wml.base + 0x5BDF320)
  local b = wml.buffer(13)
  wml.write_u32(b, id)
  wml.call(wml.base + 0x1B44BC0, rec, b, 1)
  wml.call(wml.base + 0x1B44800, rec)
end
function P.play_as_spawned()
  local e = P.object()
  if not e then return false end
  spawn_settle()
  for i = #P.spawned, 1, -1 do
    local id = P.spawned[i]
    local t = P.entry_of(id)
    local h = t and t ~= e and P.component(0x8D, t)
    if h and wml.read_u8(h + 0x104) == 0 then
      SR5TM_MY_ID = SR5TM_MY_ID or wml.read_u32(e + 0x58)
      become(id)
      return true
    end
  end
  return false
end
function P.playing_as() return SR5TM_MY_ID ~= nil end
function P.back_to_self()
  if not SR5TM_MY_ID or not P.entry_of(SR5TM_MY_ID) then SR5TM_MY_ID = nil; return false end
  become(SR5TM_MY_ID)
  SR5TM_MY_ID = nil
  return true
end
function P.check_body()
  local rec = wml.read_u64(wml.base + 0x5BDF320)
  local cur = wml.read_u32(rec + 0x10)
  if not P.entry_of(cur) or wml.read_u32(P.entry_of(cur) + 0x58) ~= cur then P.back_to_self() end
end
function P.remove_spawned()
  P.back_to_self()
  spawn_settle()
  spawn_pending = {}
  local n = 0
  for _, id in ipairs(P.spawned) do
    local e = P.entry_of(id)
    if e and wml.read_u32(e + 0x58) == id then wml.call(wml.base + 0x1E6920, e + 0x58); n = n + 1 end
  end
  P.spawned = {}
  return n
end

-- Spawning: the game's own spawner (game_customize_anywhere_spawn_lightrig,
-- +454980) step by step, so the position can be moved: look up the prefab
-- (+E8E370), request it (+E8EA40, type 7), fill the spawn struct (+1A9D3F0;
-- [0] prefab, +0x10..+0x4B the player's transform, position ints at +0x40,
-- +0x44 height, +0x48; +0x50 the layer id from +484F40(+4AA4328)+0x34),
-- spawn (+4AE810). Returns the new object, or nil.
function P.spawn_prefab(name, up, side, ahead)
  if not name or not name:find("\\", 1, true) or not name:lower():find("%.cprefab") then return nil end   -- a bare name crashes
  local B = wml.base
  local player = P.object()
  if not player or not name then return nil end
  local namep = wml.buffer(5, name)
  local filep = wml.buffer(7, "sr5_tweak_menu")
  local params = wml.buffer(6)
  local srid = wml.call(B + 0xE8E370, namep)
  if srid == 0 then return nil end
  wml.call(B + 0xE8EA40, srid, namep, 7)
  local layer = wml.call(B + 0x484F40, B + 0x4AA4328)
  if layer == 0 then return nil end
  for i = 0, 0x1F0, 8 do wml.write_u64(params + i, 0) end
  wml.call(B + 0x1A9D3F0, params)
  wml.write_u64(params, srid)
  for i = 0, 0x38, 4 do wml.write_u32(params + 0x10 + i, wml.read_u32(player + i)) end
  local function add(off, metres) wml.write_u32(params + off, (s32(wml.read_u32(params + off)) + math.floor(metres * 10000)) & 0xFFFFFFFF) end
  add(0x40, side or 0)
  add(0x44, up or 0)
  add(0x48, ahead or 0)
  wml.write_u32(params + 0x50, wml.read_u32(layer + 0x34))
  local obj = wml.call(B + 0x4AE810, 0, params, 0, filep, 1)
  return obj ~= 0 and obj or nil
end

-- Spawning a person the game's way (heads, outfits): the NPC spawner, as the
-- homie summon and encounters call it. +B39E90(&context, &id, 0, &transform,
-- &category) builds the context (id: the npc_variant's name hash; transform:
-- the player's 0x3C bytes, position moved; category: the u32 at +3C3CC38),
-- then +B3B580(0, &context, 0, 0, file, line) spawns it.
function P.spawn_npc(id, side, ahead)
  local B = wml.base
  local player = P.object()
  if not player or not id then return nil end
  local ctx, misc = wml.buffer(8), wml.buffer(9)
  for i = 0, 4088, 8 do wml.write_u64(ctx + i, 0) end
  for i = 0, 0x38, 4 do wml.write_u32(misc + i, wml.read_u32(player + i)) end
  local function add(off, metres) wml.write_u32(misc + off, (s32(wml.read_u32(misc + off)) + math.floor(metres * 10000)) & 0xFFFFFFFF) end
  add(0x30, side or 0)
  add(0x38, ahead or 0)
  wml.write_u32(misc + 0x100, id)
  wml.write_u32(misc + 0x108, wml.read_u32(B + 0x3C3CC38))
  wml.call(B + 0xB39E90, ctx, misc + 0x100, 0, misc, misc + 0x108)
  -- what they carry: a loadout variant's name hash, read by the spawn (+B3A040)
  if P.spawn_loadout then wml.write_u32(ctx + 0x260, crc_of(P.spawn_loadout)) end
  local obj = wml.call(B + 0xB3B580, 0, ctx, 0, 0, wml.buffer(7, "sr5_tweak_menu"), 1)
  -- it gives back their spawn record (see P.remember)
  if obj ~= 0 then P.remember(obj) end
  return obj ~= 0 and obj or nil
end

-- Vehicle handling (experimental): the vehicle's wheeled locomotion
-- component (type 0x12) keeps the handling it drives with in a block at
-- +0x8BC (each value resolved from the vehicle's data): +0x04 / +0x0C wheel
-- friction and max friction multipliers (flag byte +0x10), +0x2C steering
-- max angle (radians) and +0x30 the speed it's allowed up to (flag +0x48),
-- +0x5C max torque (flag +0x60), +0x74 top speed, m/s (flag +0x78). The
-- block in use is the pointer at +0x1DE8: the vehicle's own, or (seen live
-- while the player drives) the player's handling block at +0x1DD8, or a
-- mission's at +0x1DE0, which is left alone. The menu changes the block in
-- use; originals are kept per block. +1B67C30(component, block, 1) pushes a
-- block into the live physics, for the categories whose flag is set: it's
-- called after each change.
P.car = { power = 1, top = 1, grip = 1, steer = 1 }
local BLOCK, PLAYER_BLOCK, IN_USE, APPLY = 0x8BC, 0x1DD8, 0x1DE8, 0x1B67C30
local CAR = {
  power = { offs = { 0x5C }, flag = 0x60 }, top = { offs = { 0x74 }, flag = 0x78 },
  grip = { offs = { 0x04, 0x0C }, flag = 0x10 }, steer = { offs = { 0x2C, 0x30 }, flag = 0x48 },
}
local car_orig = {}   -- [block address] = { [block offset] = original value or flag }
function P.update_car()
  local v = P.vehicle_object()
  local c = v and P.component(0x12, v)
  if not c then return end
  local used = wml.read_u64(c + IN_USE)
  local b
  if used == 0 or used == c + BLOCK then b = c + BLOCK
  elseif used == wml.read_u64(c + PLAYER_BLOCK) then b = used
  else return end   -- a mission's own handling
  local o = car_orig[b]
  if not o then
    o = {}
    for _, cat in pairs(CAR) do
      for _, off in ipairs(cat.offs) do o[off] = wml.read_f32(b + off) end
      o[cat.flag] = wml.read_u8(b + cat.flag)
    end
    car_orig[b] = o
  end
  local changed, restored = false, {}
  for key, cat in pairs(CAR) do
    for _, off in ipairs(cat.offs) do
      local want = o[off] * P.car[key]
      if wml.read_f32(b + off) ~= want then
        wml.write_f32(b + off, want)
        changed = true
        if P.car[key] == 1 then restored[#restored + 1] = cat.flag end
      end
    end
    if P.car[key] ~= 1 and wml.read_u8(b + cat.flag) ~= 1 then wml.write_u8(b + cat.flag, 1); changed = true end
  end
  if changed then
    wml.call(wml.base + APPLY, c, b, 1)
    -- back to the game's: its own flag again, once the originals are pushed
    for _, flag in ipairs(restored) do wml.write_u8(b + flag, o[flag]) end
  end
end
function P.car_on() for _, v in pairs(P.car) do if v ~= 1 then return true end end return false end

-- Movement (experimental): component 0x10, in the reflection's order but 0x10 lower:
-- +0x35C in-air gain, +0x364 swimming gain. (These rows first wrote 0x1F, which is
-- the camera target, not you.) Originals are kept in a global: a reload of this file
-- must not take changed values for the game's (it did, and they compounded).
P.move = { run = 1, jump = 1, air = 1, swim = 1, gravity = 1 }
local MOVE = { air = 0x35C, swim = 0x364 }
SR5TM_MOVE_ORIG = SR5TM_MOVE_ORIG or {}
function P.update_move()
  local c = P.component(0x10)
  if not c then return end
  local o = SR5TM_MOVE_ORIG[c]
  if not o then
    o = {}
    for _, off in pairs(MOVE) do o[off] = wml.read_f32(c + off) end
    SR5TM_MOVE_ORIG = { [c] = o }   -- (one player: forget older components)
  end
  for key, off in pairs(MOVE) do
    local want = o[off] * P.move[key]
    if wml.read_f32(c + off) ~= want then wml.write_f32(c + off, want) end
  end
end
function P.move_on()
  local m = P.move
  return m.air ~= 1 or m.swim ~= 1
end

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------ saved places
P.places = {}
local PLACES = wml.root .. "\\saved_places.txt"

function P.load_places()
  P.places = {}
  local f = io.open(PLACES, "r")
  if not f then return end
  for line in f:lines() do
    local name, x, y, z = line:match("^(.-)\t([%-%d%.]+)\t([%-%d%.]+)\t([%-%d%.]+)$")
    if name then P.places[#P.places + 1] = { name = name, x = tonumber(x), y = tonumber(y), z = tonumber(z) } end
  end
  f:close()
end

function P.save_places()
  local f = io.open(PLACES, "w")
  if not f then return false end
  for _, p in ipairs(P.places) do f:write(string.format("%s\t%.4f\t%.4f\t%.4f\n", p.name, p.x, p.y, p.z)) end
  f:close()
  return true
end

function P.save_here()
  local x, y, z = P.position()
  if not x then return nil end
  local place = { name = "Place " .. (#P.places + 1), x = x, y = y, z = z }
  P.places[#P.places + 1] = place
  P.save_places()
  return place
end

P.load_places()
return P

```

`SRTweakMenu/tweaks.lua`:

```lua
-- SR5 Tweak Menu - settings kept for next time.
--
-- Every setting row (weapon and player settings, the menu's own) is saved by the
-- label of its picked option to TweakMenu\saved_tweaks.txt by Settings > Save tweaks,
-- and picked again when the menu starts. SR5TM_SESSION is what's set this session and
-- comes first, so a reload of the menu's files keeps it. Cheats aren't saved:
-- they're the game's, and it keeps its own.

local T = {}
local FILE = wml.root .. "\\saved_tweaks.txt"
T.saved = {}

function T.load()
  T.saved = {}
  local f = io.open(FILE, "r")
  if not f then return end
  for line in f:lines() do
    local k, v = line:match("^(.-)=(.*)$")
    if k then T.saved[k] = v end
  end
  f:close()
end

function T.save(rows)
  local lines = {}
  for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
    if row.options and row.save_key then lines[#lines + 1] = row.save_key .. "=" .. row.options[row.sel][1] end
  end
  table.sort(lines)
  local f = io.open(FILE, "w")
  if not f then return false end
  f:write(table.concat(lines, "\n"), "\n")
  f:close()
  return true
end

-- The saved option's index for a row, or nil.
function T.pick(row)
  local want = row.save_key and ((SR5TM_SESSION and SR5TM_SESSION[row.save_key]) or T.saved[row.save_key])
  if not want then return nil end
  for i, o in ipairs(row.options) do if o[1] == want then return i end end
  return nil
end

function T.forget()
  os.remove(FILE)
  T.saved = {}
end

T.load()
return T

```

`SRTweakMenu/vdata.lua`:

```lua
-- SR5 Tweak Menu - the game's reflection data (vlib), shared helpers.
--
-- Any field of a vlib info object (including nested ones, `m_contents.m_x`)
-- has an address the game's own lookup gives: +17D4660(field payload, &desc,
-- &index) returns the containing data, and the last descriptor's bit offset
-- is at desc+0x38. A field object is a game userdata (payload at +0x28).

local V = {}
local RESOLVE = 0x17D4660

local function ptr(v) return tonumber(tostring(v):match("(%x+)>$") or "", 16) end
local function s32(v) return v >= 0x80000000 and v - 0x100000000 or v end
V.ptr, V.s32 = ptr, s32

local buf
function V.field_addr(ud)
  local p = ptr(ud)
  if not p then return nil end
  buf = buf or wml.buffer(2)
  local base = wml.call(wml.base + RESOLVE, p + 0x28, buf, buf + 16)
  if base == 0 then return nil end
  local desc = wml.read_u64(buf)
  if desc == 0 or s32(wml.read_u32(buf + 16)) >= 0 then return nil end
  return base + (wml.read_u32(desc + 0x38) >> 3)
end

-- "f" or "i": which reading of the address matches the game's own number.
function V.typed(addr, number)
  local f = wml.read_f32(addr)
  if f == number or (number ~= 0 and math.abs(f - number) <= 1e-4 * math.abs(number)) then return "f" end
  if s32(wml.read_u32(addr)) == number then return "i" end
  return nil
end

function V.read(addr, t) if t == "i" then return s32(wml.read_u32(addr)) end return wml.read_f32(addr) end
function V.write(addr, t, v) if t == "i" then wml.write_u32(addr, math.floor(v) & 0xFFFFFFFF) else wml.write_f32(addr, v) end end

-- Every object of `class`, every field in `fields` ({ path =, what = }):
-- returns entries { addr, t, what, orig, object }. One game call per object.
function V.collect(class, fields)
  local entries = {}
  local ok, count = wml.game('local n = 0 for _ in vlib_info_object:ipairs("' .. class .. '") do n = n + 1 end return n')
  if not ok or type(count) ~= "number" then return entries end
  local exprs = {}
  for _, f in ipairs(fields) do exprs[#exprs + 1] = "o." .. f.path .. ", o." .. f.path .. ":get_number()" end
  for i = 1, count do
    local r = table.pack(wml.game('local i = 0 for _, o in vlib_info_object:ipairs("' .. class .. '") do i = i + 1 if i == ' .. i ..
      ' then return tostring(o), ' .. table.concat(exprs, ", ") .. ' end end'))
    if r[1] then
      local name = tostring(r[2]):match('"(.*)"')
      -- resolve at once, while the game still holds the field objects
      for j, f in ipairs(fields) do
        local ud, number = r[1 + 2 * j], r[2 + 2 * j]
        local a = V.field_addr(ud)
        local t = a and type(number) == "number" and V.typed(a, number)
        if t then entries[#entries + 1] = { addr = a, t = t, what = f.what, path = f.path, orig = V.read(a, t), object = name } end
      end
    end
  end
  return entries
end

return V

```

```lua
  rare = { "atv_01_beater", "compact_05_preset_1", "monster_01_ambient", "monster_01_beater", "muscle_01_preset_1", "muscle_01_preset_2", "pickup_01_bling", "pickup_01_preset_1", "police_01_ambient", "sports_01_bling", "standard_02_news_1", "standard_02_news_2", "supercar_02_bling", "suv_08_bling", "suv_08_preset_2", "suv_08_unique_parking", "veh_bike_moped_01__ambient", "veh_truck_2dr_tow_01_ambient" },
}
```

`SRTweakMenu/weapons.lua`:

```lua
-- SR5 Tweak Menu - weapon tweaks, on the game's own weapon data.
--
-- Every weapon is a gml_weapon_info (391), listed with
-- vlib_info_object:ipairs("gml_weapon_info"). A weapon's numbers live in
-- three places, and the menu changes all three:
--   1. its own fields (m_refire_delay, m_magazine_size, m_damage_player...);
--   2. its named property lists (m_weapon_float_properties /
--      m_weapon_int_properties: { m_key = the key's name hash, m_value }),
--      which override the fields (the launcher's magazine, the assault
--      rifle's refire delay are there);
--   3. each property key's m_default_value (gml_weapon_*_property_key),
--      used by weapons that don't list that property.
-- The address of any field comes from the game's own lookup, +17D4660
-- (field object -> containing object; the last field descriptor's bit
-- offset is at +0x38). The game reads these values while you play.
-- Unset values (INT_MAX, FLT_MAX, -1) mean "inherit" and are left alone.

local W = { loaded = false, count = 0 }
local RESOLVE = 0x17D4660

-- Property keys (name hash -> what the menu calls it). Names from the
-- game's gml_weapon_*_property_key lists (research/weapon_property_keys).
local FLOAT_KEYS = {
  [0x799E7CD4] = "proj_speed",    -- projectile speed
  [2068864722] = "refire",        -- refire_delay
  [3848690817] = "reload_speed",  -- reload_speed_scale
  [1030134537] = "warmup",        -- warmup_time
  [1288717430] = "charge",        -- charge_time
  [1729008533] = "overheat",      -- overheat_per_shot
  [2685072847] = "damage_all",    -- damage (everyone's: one-hit kill only)
  [3092279371] = "spread",        -- deviation_angle_start
  [3039539812] = "spread",        -- deviation_angle_end
  [3278015433] = "spread",        -- hip_fire_deviation_scalar
  [1296480626] = "feather",       -- refire_delay_feathering (0.1 s by default)
  [184102078] = "damage_player",  -- damage_avatar (a gun's own damage when you fire it)
  [1436921172] = "range",         -- range
  [0x8ABECFF9] = "radius",        -- radius (explosions from launchers and thrown weapons)
  [2003839093] = "impulse",       -- impulse
  [3476011760] = "recoil",        -- recoil_pitch
  [4628092] = "recoil",           -- recoil_heading
  [635825236] = "recoil",         -- recoil_max_pitch
  [1210448282] = "recoil",        -- recoil_max_heading
  [562308622] = "recoil",         -- hip_fire_recoil_scalar
  [665612735] = "recoil",         -- camera shake intensity
  [1177745254] = "recoil",        -- hip_fire_camera_shake_scalar
}
local INT_KEYS = {
  [2201942346] = "magazine",      -- magazine size
  [1271462471] = "single_shot",   -- is_single_shot (one shot a trigger pull)
}
-- The weapon's own fields: offset in its data, type, what.
local FIELDS = {
  { 0x5FC, "f", "damage_all" }, { 0x600, "f", "damage_player" }, { 0x604, "f", "spread" }, { 0x608, "f", "impulse" },
  { 0x60C, "f", "range" }, { 0x610, "f", "refire" }, { 0x614, "i", "magazine" },
}

-- Settings (1 = the game's own).
W.set = { magazine = 1, fire_rate = 1, damage = 1, perfect_aim = false, range = 1, knockback = 1, blast = 1,
          reload = 1, no_warmup = false, no_overheat = false, no_recoil = false, full_auto = false, rockets = false, melee_reach = 1, proj_speed = 1 }
W.NO_RELOAD = 999

local entries = {}   -- { addr =, t = "f"/"i", what =, orig = }

local function game(code)
  local r = table.pack(wml.game(code))
  if not r[1] then wml.log("weapons: game Lua error: " .. tostring(r[2])); return nil end
  return table.unpack(r, 2, r.n)
end
local function ptr(v) return tonumber(tostring(v):match("(%x+)>$") or "", 16) end
local function s32(v) return v >= 0x80000000 and v - 0x100000000 or v end

local function read(addr, t)
  if t == "i" then return s32(wml.read_u32(addr)) end
  return wml.read_f32(addr)
end
local function write(addr, t, v)
  if t == "i" then wml.write_u32(addr, math.floor(v) & 0xFFFFFFFF) else wml.write_f32(addr, v) end
end

-- Address of a field object (a game userdata), through the game's lookup.
local buf
local function field_addr(ud)
  local p = ptr(ud)
  if not p then return nil end
  buf = buf or wml.buffer(1)
  local base = wml.call(wml.base + RESOLVE, p + 0x28, buf, buf + 16)
  if base == 0 then return nil end
  local desc = wml.read_u64(buf)
  if desc == 0 or s32(wml.read_u32(buf + 16)) >= 0 then return nil end
  return base + (wml.read_u32(desc + 0x38) >> 3)
end

-- Picks "i" or "f" by which reading matches the game's own number.
local function typed(addr, number)
  local f = wml.read_f32(addr)
  if f == number or (number ~= 0 and math.abs(f - number) <= 1e-4 * math.abs(number)) then return "f" end
  if s32(wml.read_u32(addr)) == number then return "i" end
  return nil
end

local function add(addr, t, what)
  if addr and t and what then entries[#entries + 1] = { addr = addr, t = t, what = what, orig = read(addr, t) } end
end

function W.load()
  entries = {}
  local total = game([[local n = 0 for _ in vlib_info_object:ipairs("gml_weapon_info") do n = n + 1 end return n]])
  if type(total) ~= "number" or total == 0 then return false end
  local weapons = 0
  for first = 1, total, 4 do
    -- per weapon: "W", magazine field; then "F"/"I", key, value field, value
    local r = table.pack(game([[
      local i, o = 0, {}
      for _, info in vlib_info_object:ipairs("gml_weapon_info") do
        i = i + 1
        if i >= ]] .. first .. [[ and i < ]] .. (first + 4) .. [[ then
          o[#o + 1] = "W" o[#o + 1] = info.m_magazine_size
          for _, e in info.m_weapon_float_properties:ipairs() do
            o[#o + 1] = "F" o[#o + 1] = e.m_key:get_number() o[#o + 1] = e.m_value o[#o + 1] = e.m_value:get_number()
          end
          for _, e in info.m_weapon_int_properties:ipairs() do
            o[#o + 1] = "I" o[#o + 1] = e.m_key:get_number() o[#o + 1] = e.m_value o[#o + 1] = e.m_value:get_number()
          end
        end
      end
      return unpack(o)
    ]]))
    -- resolve at once, while the game still holds the field objects
    local j = 1
    while j <= r.n do
      local tag = r[j]
      if tag == "W" then
        local a = field_addr(r[j + 1])
        if a then
          local base = a - 0x614
          for _, f in ipairs(FIELDS) do add(base + f[1], f[2], f[3]) end
          weapons = weapons + 1
        end
        j = j + 2
      elseif tag == "F" or tag == "I" then
        local key, ud, number = r[j + 1], r[j + 2], r[j + 3]
        local what = (tag == "F" and FLOAT_KEYS or INT_KEYS)[key]
        if what then
          local a = field_addr(ud)
          if a then add(a, typed(a, number), what) end
        end
        j = j + 4
      else
        j = j + 1
      end
    end
  end
  -- the property keys' defaults
  for _, cls in ipairs({ { "gml_weapon_float_property_key", FLOAT_KEYS }, { "gml_weapon_int_property_key", INT_KEYS } }) do
    local r = table.pack(game([[
      local o = {}
      for _, info in vlib_info_object:ipairs("]] .. cls[1] .. [[") do
        o[#o + 1] = info o[#o + 1] = info.m_default_value o[#o + 1] = info.m_default_value:get_number()
      end
      return unpack(o)
    ]]))
    for j = 1, r.n, 3 do
      local p = ptr(r[j])
      local key = p and ((wml.read_u64(p + 0x28) >> 32) & 0xFFFFFFFF)
      local what = key and cls[2][key]
      if what then
        local a = field_addr(r[j + 1])
        if a then add(a, typed(a, r[j + 2]), what) end
      end
    end
  end
  W.count = weapons
  W.loaded = weapons > 0
  wml.log("weapons: " .. weapons .. " weapons, " .. #entries .. " values")
  return W.loaded
end

local function is_set(t, v)
  if t == "i" then return v > 0 and v < 0x7FFFFFFF end
  return v == v and v > 0 and v < 1e30
end

-- What a value should be for the current settings.
local function wanted(e)
  local v, s = e.orig, W.set
  local w = e.what
  -- One-hit kill: every weapon's player damage, inherited ones included, and
  -- the shared damage values (so it can't be missed; enemies' guns too).
  if s.damage == "kill" and (w == "damage_player" or w == "damage_all") then return 100000 end
  if w == "damage_all" then return v end
  if w == "feather" then return s.fire_rate ~= 1 and 0 or v end
  -- Full auto: no gun fires just once a trigger pull
  if w == "single_shot" then return s.full_auto and 0 or v end
  -- No recoil: kick, its limits and the camera shake from firing, all 0
  if w == "recoil" then return s.no_recoil and 0 or v end
  if w == "spread" then return (s.perfect_aim and v == v and v > 0 and v < 1e30) and 0 or v end
  if not is_set(e.t, v) then return v end
  if w == "magazine" then
    if s.magazine == "no_reload" then return W.NO_RELOAD end
    return math.max(1, math.floor(v * s.magazine + 0.5))
  elseif w == "refire" then
    -- Rockets: at most 4 a second. Near 12 a second the game shut itself down
    -- with no error (likely out of room for projectiles or explosions).
    if s.rockets then return math.max(v / s.fire_rate, 0.25) end
    -- No faster than 20 shots a second, as player.lua's cached copy: faster crashed.
    return math.min(v, math.max(v / s.fire_rate, 0.05))
  elseif w == "damage_player" then return s.damage == "kill" and 100000 or v * s.damage
  elseif w == "range" then return v * s.range
  elseif w == "melee_range" then return v * s.melee_reach
  elseif w == "proj_speed" then return v * s.proj_speed
  elseif w == "radius" then return v * s.blast
  elseif w == "impulse" then return v * s.knockback
  elseif w == "reload_speed" then return v * s.reload
  elseif w == "warmup" or w == "charge" then return s.no_warmup and 0.01 or v
  elseif w == "overheat" then return s.no_overheat and 0 or v
  end
  return v
end

-- Writes every value for the current settings.
function W.apply()
  if not W.loaded and not W.load() then return false end
  local n = 0
  for _, e in ipairs(entries) do
    -- A new gun copies the shared data, so tuning both stacked (x8 became x64):
    -- only what a gun may not list is tuned here, the rest on the gun in hand.
    local want = (e.what == "recoil" or e.what == "feather") and wanted(e) or e.orig
    if want ~= (e.written or e.orig) then write(e.addr, e.t, want); n = n + 1 end
    e.written = want
  end
  return true, n
end

-- The gun in hand. A gun keeps its own copy of most of its properties, made
-- when you switch to it, so the shared data above only reaches later copies:
-- at the weapon component (+49F8A0(+1C1F420(&gun id))), one list per fire mode
-- (0x6A0 apart): pointer +0x138, count u16 +0x140, 24-byte entries (key hash
-- +0, value +8, type +0x10: 1 float, 0 int). What the menu tunes is written
-- straight into them, with each entry's original kept for this gun; a new gun
-- starts over. (Recoil has its own code, in player.lua.)
-- Entries are found by key on every pass: the per-gun setter (special ammo,
-- rockets, recoil) adds properties to these lists, which can move them, so a
-- remembered address could end up writing over something else.
local gun_id, gun_orig   -- gun_orig: [section * 2^32 + key] = original value
function W.update_gun(force)
  if not W.loaded then return end
  local ok, str = wml.game("return tostring(gml_get_local_player_weapon())")
  local id = ok and tonumber((str or ""):match("object (%x+)") or "", 16)
  if not id or id == 0 then return end
  if id ~= gun_id then
    gun_id, gun_orig, force = id, {}, true
    W.gun_single = false
  end
  if not force then return end
  local buf = wml.buffer(15)
  wml.write_u32(buf, id)
  local entry = wml.call(wml.base + 0x1C1F420, buf)
  local comp = entry ~= 0 and wml.call(wml.base + 0x49F8A0, entry) or 0
  if comp == 0 then gun_id = nil; return end
  for section = 0, 3 do
    local list = wml.read_u64(comp + section * 0x6A0 + 0x138)
    local n = wml.read_u16(comp + section * 0x6A0 + 0x140)
    if list ~= 0 and n <= 200 then
      -- A melee attack has melee_correction_range: its range is the lunge, not how far a gun reaches.
      local melee = false
      for i = 0, n - 1 do
        if wml.read_u32(list + i * 24) == 0xA38D599A then melee = true end
      end
      for i = 0, n - 1 do
        local p = list + i * 24
        local key, kind = wml.read_u32(p), wml.read_u32(p + 0x10)
        local what = (kind == 1 and FLOAT_KEYS or kind ~= 3 and INT_KEYS or {})[key]
        if what == "range" and melee then what = "melee_range" end
        if what and what ~= "recoil" then
          local t = kind == 1 and "f" or "i"
          local slot = section * 0x100000000 + key
          local orig = gun_orig[slot]
          if orig == nil then
            orig = read(p + 8, t)
            gun_orig[slot] = orig
            if what == "single_shot" and section == 0 and orig ~= 0 then W.gun_single = true end
          end
          local want = wanted({ t = t, what = what, orig = orig })
          if read(p + 8, t) ~= want then write(p + 8, t, want) end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
function W.gun_active() return W.any_on() or gun_orig ~= nil end

-- Puts every weapon back as the game had it.
function W.restore()
  for _, e in ipairs(entries) do if e.written and e.written ~= e.orig then write(e.addr, e.t, e.orig) end e.written = nil end
end

-- Still the same data? (If the game reloaded its weapon data, load again.)
function W.check()
  local e = entries[1]
  if not e then return end
  local now = read(e.addr, e.t)
  local expect = e.written or e.orig
  if now ~= expect and not (e.t == "f" and math.abs(now - expect) <= 1e-4 * math.max(1, math.abs(expect))) then
    wml.log("weapons: the game's weapon data changed; loading it again")
    W.load()
    W.apply()
  end
end

function W.any_on()
  local s = W.set
  return s.magazine ~= 1 or s.fire_rate ~= 1 or s.damage ~= 1 or s.perfect_aim or s.range ~= 1 or s.melee_reach ~= 1 or s.proj_speed ~= 1 or s.knockback ~= 1 or s.blast ~= 1
      or s.reload ~= 1 or s.no_warmup or s.no_overheat or s.no_recoil or s.full_auto
end

return W

```

`SRTweakMenu/wingsuit.lua`:

```lua
-- SR5 Tweak Menu - wingsuit tweaks, on the game's wingsuit data.
--
-- wingsuit_info (3: default, mission_specific, vehicle_surf) holds its
-- tuning in m_contents: boost (speed 38, accel 20, duration 1.25 s, cooldown
-- 15 s), terminal velocity (44, the top speed unless boosting), gravity
-- (0.5 level, 1.0 diving), base speed decay, stall speed and duration.

local V = require("vdata")
local WS = { loaded = false }
WS.set = { cooldown = 1, boost = 1, speed = 1, glide = "game" }

local FIELDS = {
  { path = "m_contents.m_boost_cooldown", what = "cooldown" },
  { path = "m_contents.m_bounce_boost_cooldown", what = "cooldown" },
  { path = "m_contents.m_boost_speed", what = "boost" },
  { path = "m_contents.m_boost_accel", what = "boost" },
  { path = "m_contents.m_boost_duration", what = "boost" },
  { path = "m_contents.m_terminal_velocity_lateral", what = "speed" },
  { path = "m_contents.m_initial_speed", what = "speed" },
  { path = "m_contents.m_landing_speed_max", what = "speed" },
  { path = "m_contents.m_gravity_min_pct", what = "gravity" },
  { path = "m_contents.m_gravity_max_pct", what = "gravity" },
  { path = "m_contents.m_base_speed_decay", what = "decay" },
  { path = "m_contents.m_stall_speed", what = "stall" },
  { path = "m_contents.m_stall_duration", what = "stall" },
}
local entries = {}

local by_path = {}   -- "default" wingsuit's entries by field path
function WS.load()
  entries = V.collect("wingsuit_info", FIELDS)
  by_path = {}
  -- kept in a global: a reload of this file would otherwise read what it wrote as the game's own
  SR5TM_WS_ORIG = SR5TM_WS_ORIG or {}
  for _, e in ipairs(entries) do
    SR5TM_WS_ORIG[e.addr] = SR5TM_WS_ORIG[e.addr] or e.orig
    e.orig = SR5TM_WS_ORIG[e.addr]
    if e.object == "default" then by_path[e.path] = e end
  end
  WS.loaded = #entries > 0
  wml.log("wingsuit: " .. #entries .. " values")
  return WS.loaded
end

local TERMINAL_44 = 44   -- m_terminal_velocity_lateral, the game's
local function wanted(e)
  local v, s, w = e.orig, WS.set, e.what
  if w == "cooldown" then
    if s.cooldown == "none" then return 0.05 elseif s.cooldown == "short" then return math.min(v, 2) end
    return v
  elseif w == "boost" then
    -- boost speed is a cap, and if it's under top speed a boost slows you down
    if e.path == "m_contents.m_boost_speed" and (s.boost ~= 1 or s.speed ~= 1) then return math.max(v * s.boost, TERMINAL_44 * s.speed * 1.25) end
    return v * s.boost
  elseif w == "speed" then return v * s.speed
  elseif w == "gravity" then
    if s.glide == "floaty" then return v * 0.5
    elseif s.glide == "level" then return v * 0.12
    elseif s.glide == "climb" then return -0.15 end
    return v
  elseif w == "decay" then
    if s.glide == "floaty" then return v * 0.5 elseif s.glide == "level" or s.glide == "climb" then return 0 end
    return v
  elseif w == "stall" then
    if s.glide == "level" or s.glide == "climb" then return 0 end
    return v
  end
  return v
end

function WS.apply()
  if not WS.loaded and not WS.load() then return false end
  for _, e in ipairs(entries) do
    local want = wanted(e)
    if want ~= (e.written or e.orig) then V.write(e.addr, e.t, want) end
    e.written = want
  end
  return true
end

-- The player's wingsuit component (type 0xB5) keeps its own copy of these
-- numbers (angles in radians), made when the wingsuit sets up; it's written
-- too, every half second while a setting is on.
-- Offsets in the copy, by the data field they copy. The originals come from
-- the "default" wingsuit's own data (not the copy, which may have been made
-- from data we'd already changed).
local COPY = {
  { 0xB8, "m_contents.m_boost_cooldown" }, { 0x5C, "m_contents.m_bounce_boost_cooldown" },
  { 0xB0, "m_contents.m_boost_duration" }, { 0xB4, "m_contents.m_boost_speed" }, { 0xBC, "m_contents.m_boost_accel" },
  { 0xAC, "m_contents.m_terminal_velocity_lateral" }, { 0xC8, "m_contents.m_initial_speed" }, { 0x100, "m_contents.m_landing_speed_max" },
  { 0xDC, "m_contents.m_gravity_min_pct" }, { 0xE0, "m_contents.m_gravity_max_pct" }, { 0x78, "m_contents.m_base_speed_decay" },
  { 0xA0, "m_contents.m_stall_duration" }, { 0xA4, "m_contents.m_stall_speed" },
}
function WS.update_copy(P)
  if not WS.loaded and not WS.load() then return end
  local c = P.component(0xB5)
  if not c then return end
  for _, cp in ipairs(COPY) do
    local e = by_path[cp[2]]
    if e then
      local want = wanted(e)
      if wml.read_f32(c + cp[1]) ~= want then wml.write_f32(c + cp[1], want) end
    end
  end
end

-- Pulling up in Climb. Recorded in flight, gravity alone can't turn a descent into a climb. Turning the suit's
-- real velocity (component 0x86, +0 +4 +8) towards up, keeping its speed, does: a 16 m/s descent became an 11 m/s
-- climb over 3 s at full forward speed. The game's body pitch (+0x10 there) follows it down to the neutral pitch,
-- 0xB5 +0x94 in radians, positive nose down (83 degrees in the data is 0.122), so that's let go nose up while pulling.
-- +0x98 is how fast the body gets there: 5 degrees a second in the game, left behind by a climb, so faster while pulling.
local PULL_ANGLE, PULL_RATE, PULL_NEUTRAL, GAME_NEUTRAL, PULL_SPEED = 0.52, 1.2, -0.35, 0.12217, 25
local PULL_NEUTRAL_RATE, GAME_NEUTRAL_RATE = 0.5, 0.08727
local pulled
function WS.update_lift(P)
  local pull = 0
  local open = false
  if WS.set.glide == "climb" and not P.no_clip then
    local e = P.object()
    local gail = e and wml.call(wml.base + 0x1534D80, e)
    if gail and gail ~= 0 and wml.read_u32(gail + 0x324) == wml.read_u32(wml.base + 0x3C20F9C) then
      open = true
      local _, _, _, _, ly = wml.pad()
      pull = WS.test_pull or (wml.key_down("S") and 1) or (ly and ly < -7849 and (-ly - 7849) / 24919) or 0
    end
  end
  if pull <= 0 then
    if pulled then
      local c = P.component(0xB5)
      if c then wml.write_f32(c + 0x94, GAME_NEUTRAL); wml.write_f32(c + 0x98, GAME_NEUTRAL_RATE) end
      pulled = false
    end
    return
  end
  local a, c = P.component(0x86), P.component(0xB5)
  if not a or not c then return end
  wml.write_f32(c + 0x94, PULL_NEUTRAL * pull)
  wml.write_f32(c + 0x98, PULL_NEUTRAL_RATE)
  pulled = true
  local vx, vy, vz = wml.read_f32(a), wml.read_f32(a + 4), wml.read_f32(a + 8)
  local h = math.sqrt(vx * vx + vz * vz)
  local speed = math.max(math.sqrt(h * h + vy * vy), PULL_SPEED)
  local now = math.atan(vy, math.max(h, 0.01))
  local target = PULL_ANGLE * pull
  if now >= target then return end
  local angle = math.min(target, now + PULL_RATE * wml.read_f32(wml.base + 0x2E80848))
  local k = speed * math.cos(angle) / math.max(h, 0.01)
  wml.write_f32(a, vx * k)
  wml.write_f32(a + 4, speed * math.sin(angle))
  wml.write_f32(a + 8, vz * k)
end

-- Repeat boosts. The game allows one boost a flight: bit 0x40 of +0x54 on component 0x86 is set by each
-- boost and only cleared when you land and fly again. The 15 s cooldown never runs: its only reader sits
-- behind an inverted null check in the game. So the bit's cleared here while not boosting, unless an activity
-- has turned boosts off (0x80). "Every 2 s" also arms the gate's timer, 0xB5 +0x144 in ms. And +0x18,
-- the boost's clock, isn't reset by a new boost, so a repeat would end early: it's zeroed here.
local was_boosting
function WS.update_boost(P)
  local mode = WS.set.cooldown
  if mode == 1 then was_boosting = nil; return end
  local a, c = P.component(0x86), P.component(0xB5)
  if not a or not c then return end
  local f = wml.read_u8(a + 0x54)
  local boosting = f & 0x20 ~= 0
  if boosting and not was_boosting then wml.write_f32(a + 0x18, 0) end
  if not boosting and f & 0xC0 == 0x40 then
    if mode == "short" then wml.write_u32(c + 0x144, wml.read_u32(wml.base + 0x2E80878) + 2000) end
    wml.write_u8(a + 0x54, f & 0xBF)
  end
  -- held down: the boost would start and end in one frame, with the clock already past its end
  if mode == "none" and not boosting and wml.read_u8(c + 0x16C) & 0x80 ~= 0 then wml.write_f32(a + 0x18, 0) end
  was_boosting = boosting
end

function WS.restore()
  for _, e in ipairs(entries) do if e.written and e.written ~= e.orig then V.write(e.addr, e.t, e.orig) end e.written = nil end
end

function WS.any_on()
  local s = WS.set
  return s.cooldown ~= 1 or s.boost ~= 1 or s.speed ~= 1 or s.glide ~= "game"
end

return WS

```

`SRTweakMenu/world.lua`:

```lua
-- SR5 Tweak Menu - the clock and pausing the world.
--
-- The clock: its update (+1AFB5A0) advances it by [+36F6210] (game minutes a
-- second, 15) unless the lock byte +36F6216 is set. The game's own systems
-- set and clear that lock too (missions, cutscenes), so a frozen clock is
-- locked again every frame. Clock speed rewrites the rate the same way.
-- Pause world is the game's own pause (gml_game_pause): everything stops,
-- you included; the menu keeps working.

local Wd = { freeze_clock = false, clock_speed = 1, pause = false, never_wanted = false, empty_streets = false }
local LOCK, RATE = 0x36F6216, 0x36F6210
local base_rate, written_rate, paused, streets_off

function Wd.update(frame)
  if Wd.freeze_clock then
    wml.write_u8(wml.base + LOCK, 1)
    Wd.locked = true
  elseif Wd.locked then
    wml.write_u8(wml.base + LOCK, 0)
    Wd.locked = false
  end
  if frame % 30 == 0 then
    local rate = wml.read_f32(wml.base + RATE)
    if Wd.clock_speed ~= 1 then
      -- a rate we didn't write is the game's own
      if not written_rate or math.abs(rate - written_rate) > 1e-4 then base_rate = rate end
      written_rate = base_rate * Wd.clock_speed
      if math.abs(rate - written_rate) > 1e-4 then wml.write_f32(wml.base + RATE, written_rate) end
    elseif written_rate then
      if base_rate and math.abs(rate - written_rate) < 1e-4 then wml.write_f32(wml.base + RATE, base_rate) end
      written_rate, base_rate = nil, nil
    end
  end
  if Wd.pause ~= (paused or false) then
    wml.game("gml_game_pause(" .. tostring(Wd.pause) .. ")")
    paused = Wd.pause
  end
  if frame % 60 == 40 and (Wd.empty_streets or streets_off) then Wd.update_streets() end
end

-- Empty streets: the spawn manager *(+3C438D0) has a "no ambient" bit (0x40)
-- for people (+0x7DB8) and vehicles (+0x7DBC), as the game's own disable-
-- ambient nodes (+B260A0, +B26140) set it; +AF90F0 / +AFB9F0 (manager, 0)
-- then remove the ones that are out there and may go (not the car you've
-- taken: with 1 they'd all go). Missions use the same bit, so it's set again
-- every second while on, and cleared only if we set it.
local MGR, PEDS, CARS = 0x3C438D0, 0x7DB8, 0x7DBC
function Wd.update_streets()
  local mgr = wml.read_u64(wml.base + MGR)
  if mgr == 0 then return end
  if Wd.empty_streets then
    for _, off in ipairs({ PEDS, CARS }) do
      local v = wml.read_u32(mgr + off)
      if v & 0x40 == 0 then wml.write_u32(mgr + off, v | 0x40) end
    end
    wml.call(wml.base + 0xAF90F0, mgr, 0)
    wml.call(wml.base + 0xAFB9F0, mgr, 0)
    streets_off = true
  elseif streets_off then
    for _, off in ipairs({ PEDS, CARS }) do wml.write_u32(mgr + off, wml.read_u32(mgr + off) & ~0x40 & 0xFFFFFFFF) end
    streets_off = false
  end
end

-- Notoriety: the game's table, as notoriety_get_highest_non_zero_faction
-- (+A0E690) reads it: *(+2F23FF0), count u16 at +2F23FF8, 0x178 an entry;
-- +E8 the faction's name hash (the binding pairs it with gml_faction's class
-- hash as an info id), +EC points, +F0 level (non-zero while you have
-- notoriety), +F4 / +F8 min / max level; byte +15B marks a temporary entry
-- (removed at the next reset): never written.
local NOTO, NOTO_COUNT = 0x2F23FF0, 0x2F23FF8
-- The name hashes of the factions you have notoriety with (nil: none).
function Wd.wanted()
  local tbl, n = wml.read_u64(wml.base + NOTO), wml.read_u16(wml.base + NOTO_COUNT)
  if tbl == 0 or n == 0 or n > 64 then return nil end
  local out
  for i = 0, n - 1 do
    local e = tbl + i * 0x178
    if wml.read_u32(e + 0xF0) ~= 0 and wml.read_u8(e + 0x15B) == 0 then
      out = out or {}
      out[#out + 1] = wml.read_u32(e + 0xE8)
    end
  end
  return out
end

function Wd.any_on() return Wd.empty_streets or streets_off or Wd.freeze_clock or Wd.clock_speed ~= 1 or Wd.pause or Wd.locked or written_rate ~= nil or paused end

return Wd

```

```bat
@echo off
rem Builds dinput8.dll (64-bit) with the Visual Studio 2022 C++ tools.
rem Usage: build.bat [install]   - "install" also copies it into the game folder
rem (set SR5_PATH to your Saints Row (2022) sr5 folder if it isn't Epic's default).
setlocal
set "HERE=%~dp0"
set "LUA=%HERE%..\third_party\lua-5.4.9\src"
set "OUT=%HERE%..\build"
if "%SR5_PATH%"=="" set "SR5_PATH=C:\Program Files\Epic Games\SaintsRow\sr5"

where cl >nul 2>nul && goto :have_cl
set "VSDIR="
set "VSWHERE=%ProgramFiles(x86)%\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe"
if not exist "%VSWHERE%" goto :no_vswhere
for /f "usebackq delims=" %%i in (`call "%%VSWHERE%%" -latest -products * -property installationPath`) do set "VSDIR=%%i"
:no_vswhere
if "%VSDIR%"=="" if exist "%ProgramFiles(x86)%\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\BuildTools" set "VSDIR=%ProgramFiles(x86)%\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\BuildTools"
if "%VSDIR%"=="" if exist "%ProgramFiles%\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Community" set "VSDIR=%ProgramFiles%\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Community"
if not exist "%VSDIR%\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat" goto :no_vs
call "%VSDIR%\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat" >nul 2>nul
:have_cl

if not exist "%OUT%\obj" mkdir "%OUT%\obj"
pushd "%OUT%\obj"
del /q *.obj 2>nul
set "LUA_SRC="
for %%f in ("%LUA%\*.c") do if /i not "%%~nf"=="lua" if /i not "%%~nf"=="luac" call set "LUA_SRC=%%LUA_SRC%% "%%f""
cl /nologo /c /O2 /MT /W1 /TC %LUA_SRC% >nul || goto :fail
cl /nologo /c /O2 /MT /W3 /TC /I"%LUA%" "%HERE%host.c" || goto :fail
link /nologo /DLL /OUT:"%OUT%\dinput8.dll" /DEF:"%HERE%dinput8.def" *.obj user32.lib kernel32.lib || goto :fail
popd
echo Built %OUT%\dinput8.dll
if /i not "%~1"=="install" exit /b 0
copy /y "%OUT%\dinput8.dll" "%SR5_PATH%\dinput8.dll" >nul || goto :copy_failed
echo Installed into %SR5_PATH%
exit /b 0

:no_vs
echo Visual Studio 2022 C++ tools not found (install "Desktop development with C++").
exit /b 1
:copy_failed
echo Couldn't copy into "%SR5_PATH%" (is the game running?)
exit /b 1
:fail
popd
echo Build failed
exit /b 1
```
